info.title: nXus API Reference
info.description: Production-ready stable API. Includes fully tested endpoints for Vendors, Customers, Accounts, Employees, Bills, Checks, and core list & Transaction entities. Use this version for production applications.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of ArRefundCreditCards where the default limit is 150.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description:
The pagination cursor token used to retrieve the next set of records.

Capture the `nextCursor` from the response JSON and provide it here to continue fetching data.


**The 10-Second Rule:** Due to QuickBooks Desktop architectural requirements, you must request
the next page within **10 seconds** of receiving the previous response.


**Static Cursors:** Unlike some APIs, the cursor remains constant for the entire duration
of the fetch sequence until `hasMore` is `false`.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description:
Filter by one or more unique identifiers (TxnIDs).

Provide a list of strictly matched TxnIDs. This is the most efficient way to retrieve specific records.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.

parameters.name: refNumbers
parameters.description:
Filter by one or more reference numbers.

Returns transactions where the `RefNumber` exactly matches any of the provided values.

parameters.name: refNumberContains
parameters.description:
Filter by reference number (substring match).

Returns transactions where the `RefNumber` contains this string.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.

parameters.name: updatedBefore
parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or before this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **23:59:59** (end of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.

parameters.name: updatedAfter
parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or after this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **00:00:00** (beginning of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.

parameters.name: toTransactionDate
parameters.description: Filter by transaction date (end).

parameters.name: fromTransactionDate
parameters.description: Filter by transaction date (start).

parameters.name: refNumberStartsWith
parameters.description: Filter by starting reference number (startsWith).

parameters.name: refNumberEndsWith
parameters.description: Filter by ending reference number (endsWith).

parameters.name: refNumberFrom
parameters.description:
Reference number range filter (start).

Use this to return transactions whose reference number is alphabetically at or after this value.

parameters.name: refNumberTo
parameters.description:
Reference number range filter (end).

Use this to return transactions whose reference number is alphabetically at or before this value.
If both `refNumberFrom` and `refNumberTo` are specified, `refNumberTo` must be lexicographically higher.

parameters.name: accountIds
parameters.description: Filter by Account IDs

parameters.name: entityIds
parameters.description: Filter by Entity IDs (Customers, Vendors, Employees)

parameters.name: itemIds
parameters.description: Filter by Item IDs

parameters.name: classIds
parameters.description:
Filter by Class IDs

Provide a list of strictly matched ClassIDs.

parameters.name: vendorId
parameters.description: Filter by Vendor ID.

parameters.name: includeLineItems
parameters.description:
Whether to include line items (ExpenseLines, ItemLines, ItemGroupLines) in the response.
Only applies to transaction objects that support line items (Bills, Checks, Invoices, etc.)

parameters.name: includeLinkedTransactions
parameters.description: Whether to include linked transactions in the response.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description:
Limit the response to only these top-level fields. Names must match exactly (case-sensitive QbXML element names e.g. ListIDRet, NameRet, AddressRet, PhoneRet  ).

**Note:** The names specified in the list are not parsed, so you must be especially careful to supply valid
names, properly cased. No error is returned in the status code if you specify an invalid name. Notice that if you want to
return custom data or private data extensions, you must specify the DataExtRet element and you must supply the OwnerID set
to either a value of 0 (custom data) or the GUID for the private data.

parameters.name: OwnerIDs
parameters.description:
(Optional) Filter by owner GUIDs.
This is a QuickBooks-specific filter for multi-user environments.
Example: ["{12345678-1234-1234-1234-123456789012}", "{87654321-4321-4321-4321-210987654321}"]

parameters.name: X-Connection-Id
parameters.description:
Identifies which QuickBooks Desktop company file to target.

Accepts three formats:
- **Prefixed ID**: `conn_01965a3f2e7b7000b4c1d2e3f4a5b6c7`
- **Internal GUID**: `3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6`
- **Your external ID**: `acme-corp` (the `externalId` you assigned when creating the connection)

The middleware resolves any of these formats to the correct connection. Required for all QuickBooks resource operations — without it, the API cannot determine which company file to query.

parameters.name: X-Correlation-ID
parameters.description:
A unique identifier for tracing a single request through the entire system.
If not provided by the client, a new one will be generated.
This is not persisted and is used only for logging and monitoring.

parameters.name: X-Nxus-Timeout-Seconds
parameters.description:
Maximum time in seconds to wait for the queued job to be picked up and the response returned from QuickBooks Desktop.

List and streaming query operations accept **1–90** seconds (default **90**). Raise this when the QuickBooks Web Connector is configured with longer polling intervals or the target company file is slow to respond.

Passed as a request header — not a query-string value.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of Bills where the default limit is 150.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description:
The pagination cursor token used to retrieve the next set of records.

Capture the `nextCursor` from the response JSON and provide it here to continue fetching data.


**The 10-Second Rule:** Due to QuickBooks Desktop architectural requirements, you must request
the next page within **10 seconds** of receiving the previous response.


**Static Cursors:** Unlike some APIs, the cursor remains constant for the entire duration
of the fetch sequence until `hasMore` is `false`.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description:
Filter by one or more unique identifiers (TxnIDs).

Provide a list of strictly matched TxnIDs. This is the most efficient way to retrieve specific records.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.

parameters.name: refNumbers
parameters.description:
Filter by one or more reference numbers.

Returns transactions where the `RefNumber` exactly matches any of the provided values.

parameters.name: refNumberContains
parameters.description:
Filter by reference number (substring match).

Returns transactions where the `RefNumber` contains this string.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.

parameters.name: updatedBefore
parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or before this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **23:59:59** (end of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.

parameters.name: updatedAfter
parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or after this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **00:00:00** (beginning of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.

parameters.name: toTransactionDate
parameters.description: Filter by transaction date (end).

parameters.name: fromTransactionDate
parameters.description: Filter by transaction date (start).

parameters.name: paymentStatus
parameters.description: Filter for paid, not paid, or both. Values: All, PaidOnly, NotPaidOnly

parameters.name: refNumberStartsWith
parameters.description: Filter by starting reference number (startsWith).

parameters.name: refNumberEndsWith
parameters.description: Filter by ending reference number (endsWith).

parameters.name: refNumberFrom
parameters.description:
Reference number range filter (start).

Use this to return transactions whose reference number is alphabetically at or after this value.

parameters.name: refNumberTo
parameters.description:
Reference number range filter (end).

Use this to return transactions whose reference number is alphabetically at or before this value.
If both `refNumberFrom` and `refNumberTo` are specified, `refNumberTo` must be lexicographically higher.

parameters.name: accountIds
parameters.description: Filter by Account IDs

parameters.name: entityIds
parameters.description: Filter by Entity IDs (Customers, Vendors, Employees)

parameters.name: itemIds
parameters.description: Filter by Item IDs

parameters.name: classIds
parameters.description:
Filter by Class IDs

Provide a list of strictly matched ClassIDs.

parameters.name: vendorId
parameters.description: Filter by Vendor ID.

parameters.name: includeLineItems
parameters.description:
Whether to include line items (ExpenseLines, ItemLines, ItemGroupLines) in the response.
Only applies to transaction objects that support line items (Bills, Checks, Invoices, etc.)

parameters.name: includeLinkedTransactions
parameters.description: Whether to include linked transactions in the response.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description:
Limit the response to only these top-level fields. Names must match exactly (case-sensitive QbXML element names e.g. ListIDRet, NameRet, AddressRet, PhoneRet  ).

**Note:** The names specified in the list are not parsed, so you must be especially careful to supply valid
names, properly cased. No error is returned in the status code if you specify an invalid name. Notice that if you want to
return custom data or private data extensions, you must specify the DataExtRet element and you must supply the OwnerID set
to either a value of 0 (custom data) or the GUID for the private data.

Passed as a request header — not a query-string value.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of CheckBills where the default limit is 150.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description:
The pagination cursor token used to retrieve the next set of records.

Capture the `nextCursor` from the response JSON and provide it here to continue fetching data.


**The 10-Second Rule:** Due to QuickBooks Desktop architectural requirements, you must request
the next page within **10 seconds** of receiving the previous response.


**Static Cursors:** Unlike some APIs, the cursor remains constant for the entire duration
of the fetch sequence until `hasMore` is `false`.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description:
Filter by one or more unique identifiers (TxnIDs).

Provide a list of strictly matched TxnIDs. This is the most efficient way to retrieve specific records.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.

parameters.name: refNumbers
parameters.description:
Filter by one or more reference numbers.

Returns transactions where the `RefNumber` exactly matches any of the provided values.

parameters.name: refNumberContains
parameters.description:
Filter by reference number (substring match).

Returns transactions where the `RefNumber` contains this string.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.

parameters.name: updatedBefore
parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or before this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **23:59:59** (end of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.

parameters.name: updatedAfter
parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or after this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **00:00:00** (beginning of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.

parameters.name: toTransactionDate
parameters.description: Filter by transaction date (end).

parameters.name: fromTransactionDate
parameters.description: Filter by transaction date (start).

parameters.name: refNumberStartsWith
parameters.description: Filter by starting reference number (startsWith).

parameters.name: refNumberEndsWith
parameters.description: Filter by ending reference number (endsWith).

parameters.name: refNumberFrom
parameters.description:
Reference number range filter (start).

Use this to return transactions whose reference number is alphabetically at or after this value.

parameters.name: refNumberTo
parameters.description:
Reference number range filter (end).

Use this to return transactions whose reference number is alphabetically at or before this value.
If both `refNumberFrom` and `refNumberTo` are specified, `refNumberTo` must be lexicographically higher.

parameters.name: accountIds
parameters.description: Filter by Account IDs

parameters.name: entityIds
parameters.description: Filter by Entity IDs (Customers, Vendors, Employees)

parameters.name: itemIds
parameters.description: Filter by Item IDs

parameters.name: classIds
parameters.description:
Filter by Class IDs

Provide a list of strictly matched ClassIDs.

parameters.name: vendorId
parameters.description: Filter by Vendor ID.

parameters.name: includeLineItems
parameters.description:
Whether to include line items (ExpenseLines, ItemLines, ItemGroupLines) in the response.
Only applies to transaction objects that support line items (Bills, Checks, Invoices, etc.)

parameters.name: includeLinkedTransactions
parameters.description: Whether to include linked transactions in the response.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description:
Limit the response to only these top-level fields. Names must match exactly (case-sensitive QbXML element names e.g. ListIDRet, NameRet, AddressRet, PhoneRet  ).

**Note:** The names specified in the list are not parsed, so you must be especially careful to supply valid
names, properly cased. No error is returned in the status code if you specify an invalid name. Notice that if you want to
return custom data or private data extensions, you must specify the DataExtRet element and you must supply the OwnerID set
to either a value of 0 (custom data) or the GUID for the private data.

parameters.name: IsPrintedStatus
parameters.description:
(Optional) Filter by check printed status.
Valid values: "NotSet", "ToBePrinted", "ToBeEmailed"
This is specific to Check transactions.

parameters.name: OwnerIDs
parameters.description:
(Optional) Filter by owner GUIDs.
This is a QuickBooks-specific filter for multi-user environments.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of Checks where the default limit is 150.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description:
The pagination cursor token used to retrieve the next set of records.

Capture the `nextCursor` from the response JSON and provide it here to continue fetching data.


**The 10-Second Rule:** Due to QuickBooks Desktop architectural requirements, you must request
the next page within **10 seconds** of receiving the previous response.


**Static Cursors:** Unlike some APIs, the cursor remains constant for the entire duration
of the fetch sequence until `hasMore` is `false`.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description:
Filter by one or more unique identifiers (TxnIDs).

Provide a list of strictly matched TxnIDs. This is the most efficient way to retrieve specific records.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.

parameters.name: refNumbers
parameters.description:
Filter by one or more reference numbers.

Returns transactions where the `RefNumber` exactly matches any of the provided values.

parameters.name: refNumberContains
parameters.description:
Filter by reference number (substring match).

Returns transactions where the `RefNumber` contains this string.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.

parameters.name: updatedBefore
parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or before this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **23:59:59** (end of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.

parameters.name: updatedAfter
parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or after this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **00:00:00** (beginning of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.

parameters.name: toTransactionDate
parameters.description: Filter by transaction date (end).

parameters.name: fromTransactionDate
parameters.description: Filter by transaction date (start).

parameters.name: refNumberStartsWith
parameters.description: Filter by starting reference number (startsWith).

parameters.name: refNumberEndsWith
parameters.description: Filter by ending reference number (endsWith).

parameters.name: refNumberFrom
parameters.description:
Reference number range filter (start).

Use this to return transactions whose reference number is alphabetically at or after this value.

parameters.name: refNumberTo
parameters.description:
Reference number range filter (end).

Use this to return transactions whose reference number is alphabetically at or before this value.
If both `refNumberFrom` and `refNumberTo` are specified, `refNumberTo` must be lexicographically higher.

parameters.name: accountIds
parameters.description: Filter by Account IDs

parameters.name: entityIds
parameters.description: Filter by Entity IDs (Customers, Vendors, Employees)

parameters.name: itemIds
parameters.description: Filter by Item IDs

parameters.name: classIds
parameters.description:
Filter by Class IDs

Provide a list of strictly matched ClassIDs.

parameters.name: vendorId
parameters.description: Filter by Vendor ID.

parameters.name: includeLineItems
parameters.description:
Whether to include line items (ExpenseLines, ItemLines, ItemGroupLines) in the response.
Only applies to transaction objects that support line items (Bills, Checks, Invoices, etc.)

parameters.name: includeLinkedTransactions
parameters.description: Whether to include linked transactions in the response.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description:
Limit the response to only these top-level fields. Names must match exactly (case-sensitive QbXML element names e.g. ListIDRet, NameRet, AddressRet, PhoneRet  ).

**Note:** The names specified in the list are not parsed, so you must be especially careful to supply valid
names, properly cased. No error is returned in the status code if you specify an invalid name. Notice that if you want to
return custom data or private data extensions, you must specify the DataExtRet element and you must supply the OwnerID set
to either a value of 0 (custom data) or the GUID for the private data.

parameters.name: X-Connection-Id
parameters.description:
Identifies which QuickBooks Desktop company file to target.

Accepts three formats:
- **Prefixed ID**: `conn_01965a3f2e7b7000b4c1d2e3f4a5b6c7`
- **Internal GUID**: `3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6`
- **Your external ID**: `acme-corp` (the `externalId` you assigned when creating the connection)

The middleware resolves any of these formats to the correct connection. Required for all QuickBooks resource operations — without it, the API cannot determine which company file to query.

parameters.name: X-Correlation-ID
parameters.description:
A unique identifier for tracing a single request through the entire system.
If not provided by the client, a new one will be generated.
This is not persisted and is used only for logging and monitoring.

parameters.name: X-Nxus-Timeout-Seconds
parameters.description:
Maximum time in seconds to wait for the queued job to be picked up and the response returned from QuickBooks Desktop.

List and streaming query operations accept **1–90** seconds (default **90**). Raise this when the QuickBooks Web Connector is configured with longer polling intervals or the target company file is slow to respond.

Passed as a request header — not a query-string value.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of CreditCardBills where the default limit is 150.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description:
The pagination cursor token used to retrieve the next set of records.

Capture the `nextCursor` from the response JSON and provide it here to continue fetching data.


**The 10-Second Rule:** Due to QuickBooks Desktop architectural requirements, you must request
the next page within **10 seconds** of receiving the previous response.


**Static Cursors:** Unlike some APIs, the cursor remains constant for the entire duration
of the fetch sequence until `hasMore` is `false`.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description:
Filter by one or more unique identifiers (TxnIDs).

Provide a list of strictly matched TxnIDs. This is the most efficient way to retrieve specific records.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.

parameters.name: refNumbers
parameters.description:
Filter by one or more reference numbers.

Returns transactions where the `RefNumber` exactly matches any of the provided values.

parameters.name: refNumberContains
parameters.description:
Filter by reference number (substring match).

Returns transactions where the `RefNumber` contains this string.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.

parameters.name: updatedBefore
parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or before this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **23:59:59** (end of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.

parameters.name: updatedAfter
parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or after this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **00:00:00** (beginning of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.

parameters.name: toTransactionDate
parameters.description: Filter by transaction date (end).

parameters.name: fromTransactionDate
parameters.description: Filter by transaction date (start).

parameters.name: refNumberStartsWith
parameters.description: Filter by starting reference number (startsWith).

parameters.name: refNumberEndsWith
parameters.description: Filter by ending reference number (endsWith).

parameters.name: refNumberFrom
parameters.description:
Reference number range filter (start).

Use this to return transactions whose reference number is alphabetically at or after this value.

parameters.name: refNumberTo
parameters.description:
Reference number range filter (end).

Use this to return transactions whose reference number is alphabetically at or before this value.
If both `refNumberFrom` and `refNumberTo` are specified, `refNumberTo` must be lexicographically higher.

parameters.name: accountIds
parameters.description: Filter by Account IDs

parameters.name: entityIds
parameters.description: Filter by Entity IDs (Customers, Vendors, Employees)

parameters.name: itemIds
parameters.description: Filter by Item IDs

parameters.name: classIds
parameters.description:
Filter by Class IDs

Provide a list of strictly matched ClassIDs.

parameters.name: vendorId
parameters.description: Filter by Vendor ID.

parameters.name: includeLineItems
parameters.description:
Whether to include line items (ExpenseLines, ItemLines, ItemGroupLines) in the response.
Only applies to transaction objects that support line items (Bills, Checks, Invoices, etc.)

parameters.name: includeLinkedTransactions
parameters.description: Override to disable linked transactions filter for this resource

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description:
Limit the response to only these top-level fields. Names must match exactly (case-sensitive QbXML element names e.g. ListIDRet, NameRet, AddressRet, PhoneRet  ).

**Note:** The names specified in the list are not parsed, so you must be especially careful to supply valid
names, properly cased. No error is returned in the status code if you specify an invalid name. Notice that if you want to
return custom data or private data extensions, you must specify the DataExtRet element and you must supply the OwnerID set
to either a value of 0 (custom data) or the GUID for the private data.

parameters.name: APAccountId
parameters.description:
(Optional) Filter by Accounts Payable account ListID.
This is specific to bill payment transactions.
Example: "80000002-5678"

parameters.name: OwnerIDs
parameters.description:
(Optional) Filter by owner GUIDs.
This is a QuickBooks-specific filter for multi-user environments.
Example: ["{12345678-1234-1234-1234-123456789012}", "{87654321-4321-4321-4321-210987654321}"]

get.description: Returns a paginated list of CreditCardCredits where the default limit is 150.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description:
The pagination cursor token used to retrieve the next set of records.

Capture the `nextCursor` from the response JSON and provide it here to continue fetching data.


**The 10-Second Rule:** Due to QuickBooks Desktop architectural requirements, you must request
the next page within **10 seconds** of receiving the previous response.


**Static Cursors:** Unlike some APIs, the cursor remains constant for the entire duration
of the fetch sequence until `hasMore` is `false`.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description:
Filter by one or more unique identifiers (TxnIDs).

Provide a list of strictly matched TxnIDs. This is the most efficient way to retrieve specific records.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.

parameters.name: refNumbers
parameters.description:
Filter by one or more reference numbers.

Returns transactions where the `RefNumber` exactly matches any of the provided values.

parameters.name: refNumberContains
parameters.description:
Filter by reference number (substring match).

Returns transactions where the `RefNumber` contains this string.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.

parameters.name: updatedBefore
parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or before this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **23:59:59** (end of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.

parameters.name: updatedAfter
parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or after this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **00:00:00** (beginning of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.

parameters.name: toTransactionDate
parameters.description: Filter by transaction date (end).

parameters.name: fromTransactionDate
parameters.description: Filter by transaction date (start).

parameters.name: refNumberStartsWith
parameters.description: Filter by starting reference number (startsWith).

parameters.name: refNumberEndsWith
parameters.description: Filter by ending reference number (endsWith).

parameters.name: refNumberFrom
parameters.description:
Reference number range filter (start).

Use this to return transactions whose reference number is alphabetically at or after this value.

parameters.name: refNumberTo
parameters.description:
Reference number range filter (end).

Use this to return transactions whose reference number is alphabetically at or before this value.
If both `refNumberFrom` and `refNumberTo` are specified, `refNumberTo` must be lexicographically higher.

parameters.name: accountIds
parameters.description: Filter by Account IDs

parameters.name: entityIds
parameters.description: Filter by Entity IDs (Customers, Vendors, Employees)

parameters.name: itemIds
parameters.description: Filter by Item IDs

parameters.name: classIds
parameters.description:
Filter by Class IDs

Provide a list of strictly matched ClassIDs.

parameters.name: vendorId
parameters.description: Filter by Vendor ID.

parameters.name: includeLineItems
parameters.description:
Whether to include line items (ExpenseLines, ItemLines, ItemGroupLines) in the response.
Only applies to transaction objects that support line items (Bills, Checks, Invoices, etc.)

parameters.name: includeLinkedTransactions
parameters.description: Whether to include linked transactions in the response.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description:
Limit the response to only these top-level fields. Names must match exactly (case-sensitive QbXML element names e.g. ListIDRet, NameRet, AddressRet, PhoneRet  ).

**Note:** The names specified in the list are not parsed, so you must be especially careful to supply valid
names, properly cased. No error is returned in the status code if you specify an invalid name. Notice that if you want to
return custom data or private data extensions, you must specify the DataExtRet element and you must supply the OwnerID set
to either a value of 0 (custom data) or the GUID for the private data.

parameters.name: OwnerIDs
parameters.description:
(Optional) Filter by owner GUIDs.
This is a QuickBooks-specific filter for multi-user environments.
Example: ["{12345678-1234-1234-1234-123456789012}", "{87654321-4321-4321-4321-210987654321}"]

get.description: Returns a paginated list of Deposits where the default limit is 150.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description:
The pagination cursor token used to retrieve the next set of records.

Capture the `nextCursor` from the response JSON and provide it here to continue fetching data.


**The 10-Second Rule:** Due to QuickBooks Desktop architectural requirements, you must request
the next page within **10 seconds** of receiving the previous response.


**Static Cursors:** Unlike some APIs, the cursor remains constant for the entire duration
of the fetch sequence until `hasMore` is `false`.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description:
Filter by one or more unique identifiers (TxnIDs).

Provide a list of strictly matched TxnIDs. This is the most efficient way to retrieve specific records.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.

parameters.name: refNumbers
parameters.description:
Filter by one or more reference numbers.

Returns transactions where the `RefNumber` exactly matches any of the provided values.

parameters.name: refNumberContains
parameters.description:
Filter by reference number (substring match).

Returns transactions where the `RefNumber` contains this string.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.

parameters.name: updatedBefore
parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or before this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **23:59:59** (end of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.

parameters.name: updatedAfter
parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or after this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **00:00:00** (beginning of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.

parameters.name: toTransactionDate
parameters.description: Filter by transaction date (end).

parameters.name: fromTransactionDate
parameters.description: Filter by transaction date (start).

parameters.name: refNumberStartsWith
parameters.description: Filter by starting reference number (startsWith).

parameters.name: refNumberEndsWith
parameters.description: Filter by ending reference number (endsWith).

parameters.name: refNumberFrom
parameters.description:
Reference number range filter (start).

Use this to return transactions whose reference number is alphabetically at or after this value.

parameters.name: refNumberTo
parameters.description:
Reference number range filter (end).

Use this to return transactions whose reference number is alphabetically at or before this value.
If both `refNumberFrom` and `refNumberTo` are specified, `refNumberTo` must be lexicographically higher.

parameters.name: accountIds
parameters.description: Filter by Account IDs

parameters.name: entityIds
parameters.description: Filter by Entity IDs (Customers, Vendors, Employees)

parameters.name: itemIds
parameters.description: Filter by Item IDs

parameters.name: classIds
parameters.description:
Filter by Class IDs

Provide a list of strictly matched ClassIDs.

parameters.name: vendorId
parameters.description: Filter by Vendor ID.

parameters.name: includeLineItems
parameters.description:
Whether to include line items (ExpenseLines, ItemLines, ItemGroupLines) in the response.
Only applies to transaction objects that support line items (Bills, Checks, Invoices, etc.)

parameters.name: includeLinkedTransactions
parameters.description: Whether to include linked transactions in the response.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description:
Limit the response to only these top-level fields. Names must match exactly (case-sensitive QbXML element names e.g. ListIDRet, NameRet, AddressRet, PhoneRet  ).

**Note:** The names specified in the list are not parsed, so you must be especially careful to supply valid
names, properly cased. No error is returned in the status code if you specify an invalid name. Notice that if you want to
return custom data or private data extensions, you must specify the DataExtRet element and you must supply the OwnerID set
to either a value of 0 (custom data) or the GUID for the private data.

parameters.name: OwnerIDs
parameters.description:
(Optional) Filter by owner GUIDs.
This is a QuickBooks-specific filter for multi-user environments.
Example: ["{12345678-1234-1234-1234-123456789012}", "{87654321-4321-4321-4321-210987654321}"]

parameters.name: X-Connection-Id
parameters.description:
Identifies which QuickBooks Desktop company file to target.

Accepts three formats:
- **Prefixed ID**: `conn_01965a3f2e7b7000b4c1d2e3f4a5b6c7`
- **Internal GUID**: `3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6`
- **Your external ID**: `acme-corp` (the `externalId` you assigned when creating the connection)

The middleware resolves any of these formats to the correct connection. Required for all QuickBooks resource operations — without it, the API cannot determine which company file to query.

parameters.name: X-Correlation-ID
parameters.description:
A unique identifier for tracing a single request through the entire system.
If not provided by the client, a new one will be generated.
This is not persisted and is used only for logging and monitoring.

parameters.name: X-Nxus-Timeout-Seconds
parameters.description:
Maximum time in seconds to wait for the queued job to be picked up and the response returned from QuickBooks Desktop.

List and streaming query operations accept **1–90** seconds (default **90**). Raise this when the QuickBooks Web Connector is configured with longer polling intervals or the target company file is slow to respond.

Passed as a request header — not a query-string value.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of Estimates where the default limit is 150.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description:
The pagination cursor token used to retrieve the next set of records.

Capture the `nextCursor` from the response JSON and provide it here to continue fetching data.


**The 10-Second Rule:** Due to QuickBooks Desktop architectural requirements, you must request
the next page within **10 seconds** of receiving the previous response.


**Static Cursors:** Unlike some APIs, the cursor remains constant for the entire duration
of the fetch sequence until `hasMore` is `false`.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description:
Filter by one or more unique identifiers (TxnIDs).

Provide a list of strictly matched TxnIDs. This is the most efficient way to retrieve specific records.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.

parameters.name: refNumbers
parameters.description:
Filter by one or more reference numbers.

Returns transactions where the `RefNumber` exactly matches any of the provided values.

parameters.name: refNumberContains
parameters.description:
Filter by reference number (substring match).

Returns transactions where the `RefNumber` contains this string.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.

parameters.name: updatedBefore
parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or before this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **23:59:59** (end of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.

parameters.name: updatedAfter
parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or after this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **00:00:00** (beginning of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.

parameters.name: toTransactionDate
parameters.description: Filter by transaction date (end).

parameters.name: fromTransactionDate
parameters.description: Filter by transaction date (start).

parameters.name: refNumberStartsWith
parameters.description: Filter by starting reference number (startsWith).

parameters.name: refNumberEndsWith
parameters.description: Filter by ending reference number (endsWith).

parameters.name: refNumberFrom
parameters.description:
Reference number range filter (start).

Use this to return transactions whose reference number is alphabetically at or after this value.

parameters.name: refNumberTo
parameters.description:
Reference number range filter (end).

Use this to return transactions whose reference number is alphabetically at or before this value.
If both `refNumberFrom` and `refNumberTo` are specified, `refNumberTo` must be lexicographically higher.

parameters.name: accountIds
parameters.description: Filter by Account IDs

parameters.name: entityIds
parameters.description: Filter by Entity IDs (Customers, Vendors, Employees)

parameters.name: itemIds
parameters.description: Filter by Item IDs

parameters.name: classIds
parameters.description:
Filter by Class IDs

Provide a list of strictly matched ClassIDs.

parameters.name: vendorId
parameters.description: Filter by Vendor ID.

parameters.name: includeLineItems
parameters.description:
Whether to include line items (ExpenseLines, ItemLines, ItemGroupLines) in the response.
Only applies to transaction objects that support line items (Bills, Checks, Invoices, etc.)

parameters.name: includeLinkedTransactions
parameters.description: Whether to include linked transactions in the response.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description:
Limit the response to only these top-level fields. Names must match exactly (case-sensitive QbXML element names e.g. ListIDRet, NameRet, AddressRet, PhoneRet  ).

**Note:** The names specified in the list are not parsed, so you must be especially careful to supply valid
names, properly cased. No error is returned in the status code if you specify an invalid name. Notice that if you want to
return custom data or private data extensions, you must specify the DataExtRet element and you must supply the OwnerID set
to either a value of 0 (custom data) or the GUID for the private data.

parameters.name: X-Connection-Id
parameters.description:
Identifies which QuickBooks Desktop company file to target.

Accepts three formats:
- **Prefixed ID**: `conn_01965a3f2e7b7000b4c1d2e3f4a5b6c7`
- **Internal GUID**: `3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6`
- **Your external ID**: `acme-corp` (the `externalId` you assigned when creating the connection)

The middleware resolves any of these formats to the correct connection. Required for all QuickBooks resource operations — without it, the API cannot determine which company file to query.

parameters.name: X-Correlation-ID
parameters.description:
A unique identifier for tracing a single request through the entire system.
If not provided by the client, a new one will be generated.
This is not persisted and is used only for logging and monitoring.

List and streaming query operations accept **1–90** seconds (default **90**). Raise this when the QuickBooks Web Connector is configured with longer polling intervals or the target company file is slow to respond.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of ItemReceipts where the default limit is 150.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description:
The pagination cursor token used to retrieve the next set of records.

Capture the `nextCursor` from the response JSON and provide it here to continue fetching data.


**The 10-Second Rule:** Due to QuickBooks Desktop architectural requirements, you must request
the next page within **10 seconds** of receiving the previous response.


**Static Cursors:** Unlike some APIs, the cursor remains constant for the entire duration
of the fetch sequence until `hasMore` is `false`.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description:
Filter by one or more unique identifiers (TxnIDs).

Provide a list of strictly matched TxnIDs. This is the most efficient way to retrieve specific records.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.

parameters.name: refNumbers
parameters.description:
Filter by one or more reference numbers.

Returns transactions where the `RefNumber` exactly matches any of the provided values.

parameters.name: refNumberContains
parameters.description:
Filter by reference number (substring match).

Returns transactions where the `RefNumber` contains this string.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.

parameters.name: updatedBefore
parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or before this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **23:59:59** (end of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.

parameters.name: updatedAfter
parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or after this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **00:00:00** (beginning of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.

parameters.name: toTransactionDate
parameters.description: Filter by transaction date (end).

parameters.name: fromTransactionDate
parameters.description: Filter by transaction date (start).

parameters.name: refNumberStartsWith
parameters.description: Filter by starting reference number (startsWith).

parameters.name: refNumberEndsWith
parameters.description: Filter by ending reference number (endsWith).

parameters.name: refNumberFrom
parameters.description:
Reference number range filter (start).

Use this to return transactions whose reference number is alphabetically at or after this value.

parameters.name: refNumberTo
parameters.description:
Reference number range filter (end).

Use this to return transactions whose reference number is alphabetically at or before this value.
If both `refNumberFrom` and `refNumberTo` are specified, `refNumberTo` must be lexicographically higher.

parameters.name: accountIds
parameters.description: Filter by Account IDs

parameters.name: entityIds
parameters.description: Filter by Entity IDs (Customers, Vendors, Employees)

parameters.name: itemIds
parameters.description: Filter by Item IDs

parameters.name: classIds
parameters.description:
Filter by Class IDs

Provide a list of strictly matched ClassIDs.

parameters.name: vendorId
parameters.description: Filter by Vendor ID.

parameters.name: includeLineItems
parameters.description:
Whether to include line items (ExpenseLines, ItemLines, ItemGroupLines) in the response.
Only applies to transaction objects that support line items (Bills, Checks, Invoices, etc.)

parameters.name: includeLinkedTransactions
parameters.description: Whether to include linked transactions in the response.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description:
Limit the response to only these top-level fields. Names must match exactly (case-sensitive QbXML element names e.g. ListIDRet, NameRet, AddressRet, PhoneRet  ).

**Note:** The names specified in the list are not parsed, so you must be especially careful to supply valid
names, properly cased. No error is returned in the status code if you specify an invalid name. Notice that if you want to
return custom data or private data extensions, you must specify the DataExtRet element and you must supply the OwnerID set
to either a value of 0 (custom data) or the GUID for the private data.

parameters.name: EndDate
parameters.description: Filter by transaction date range - end date.

parameters.name: RefNumber
parameters.description: Filter by RefNumber (transaction reference).

parameters.name: StartDate
parameters.description: Filter by Vendor ListID.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of JournalEntrys where the default limit is 150.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description:
The pagination cursor token used to retrieve the next set of records.

Capture the `nextCursor` from the response JSON and provide it here to continue fetching data.


**The 10-Second Rule:** Due to QuickBooks Desktop architectural requirements, you must request
the next page within **10 seconds** of receiving the previous response.


**Static Cursors:** Unlike some APIs, the cursor remains constant for the entire duration
of the fetch sequence until `hasMore` is `false`.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description:
Filter by one or more unique identifiers (TxnIDs).

Provide a list of strictly matched TxnIDs. This is the most efficient way to retrieve specific records.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.

parameters.name: refNumbers
parameters.description:
Filter by one or more reference numbers.

Returns transactions where the `RefNumber` exactly matches any of the provided values.

parameters.name: refNumberContains
parameters.description:
Filter by reference number (substring match).

Returns transactions where the `RefNumber` contains this string.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.

parameters.name: updatedBefore
parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or before this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **23:59:59** (end of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.

parameters.name: updatedAfter
parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or after this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **00:00:00** (beginning of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.

parameters.name: toTransactionDate
parameters.description: Filter by transaction date (end).

parameters.name: fromTransactionDate
parameters.description: Filter by transaction date (start).

parameters.name: refNumberStartsWith
parameters.description: Filter by starting reference number (startsWith).

parameters.name: refNumberEndsWith
parameters.description: Filter by ending reference number (endsWith).

parameters.name: refNumberFrom
parameters.description:
Reference number range filter (start).

Use this to return transactions whose reference number is alphabetically at or after this value.

parameters.name: refNumberTo
parameters.description:
Reference number range filter (end).

Use this to return transactions whose reference number is alphabetically at or before this value.
If both `refNumberFrom` and `refNumberTo` are specified, `refNumberTo` must be lexicographically higher.

parameters.name: accountIds
parameters.description: Filter by Account IDs

parameters.name: entityIds
parameters.description: Filter by Entity IDs (Customers, Vendors, Employees)

parameters.name: itemIds
parameters.description: Filter by Item IDs

parameters.name: classIds
parameters.description:
Filter by Class IDs

Provide a list of strictly matched ClassIDs.

parameters.name: vendorId
parameters.description: Filter by Vendor ID.

parameters.name: includeLineItems
parameters.description:
Whether to include line items (ExpenseLines, ItemLines, ItemGroupLines) in the response.
Only applies to transaction objects that support line items (Bills, Checks, Invoices, etc.)

parameters.name: includeLinkedTransactions
parameters.description: Whether to include linked transactions in the response.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description:
Limit the response to only these top-level fields. Names must match exactly (case-sensitive QbXML element names e.g. ListIDRet, NameRet, AddressRet, PhoneRet  ).

**Note:** The names specified in the list are not parsed, so you must be especially careful to supply valid
names, properly cased. No error is returned in the status code if you specify an invalid name. Notice that if you want to
return custom data or private data extensions, you must specify the DataExtRet element and you must supply the OwnerID set
to either a value of 0 (custom data) or the GUID for the private data.

parameters.name: IsAdjustment
parameters.description: Filter for adjustment entries (journal-entry-specific filter)

parameters.name: X-Connection-Id
parameters.description:
Identifies which QuickBooks Desktop company file to target.

Accepts three formats:
- **Prefixed ID**: `conn_01965a3f2e7b7000b4c1d2e3f4a5b6c7`
- **Internal GUID**: `3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6`
- **Your external ID**: `acme-corp` (the `externalId` you assigned when creating the connection)

The middleware resolves any of these formats to the correct connection. Required for all QuickBooks resource operations — without it, the API cannot determine which company file to query.

parameters.name: X-Correlation-ID
parameters.description:
A unique identifier for tracing a single request through the entire system.
If not provided by the client, a new one will be generated.
This is not persisted and is used only for logging and monitoring.

parameters.name: X-Nxus-Timeout-Seconds
parameters.description:
Maximum time in seconds to wait for the queued job to be picked up and the response returned from QuickBooks Desktop.

List and streaming query operations accept **1–90** seconds (default **90**). Raise this when the QuickBooks Web Connector is configured with longer polling intervals or the target company file is slow to respond.

Passed as a request header — not a query-string value.

parameters.name: X-Connection-Id
parameters.description:
Identifies which QuickBooks Desktop company file to target.

Accepts three formats:
- **Prefixed ID**: `conn_01965a3f2e7b7000b4c1d2e3f4a5b6c7`
- **Internal GUID**: `3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6`
- **Your external ID**: `acme-corp` (the `externalId` you assigned when creating the connection)

The middleware resolves any of these formats to the correct connection. Required for all QuickBooks resource operations — without it, the API cannot determine which company file to query.

parameters.name: X-Nxus-Timeout-Seconds
parameters.description:
Maximum time in seconds to wait for the queued job to be picked up and the response returned from QuickBooks Desktop.

Create / update / delete and single-entity retrieval operations accept **1–120** seconds (default **120**). Raise this when the QuickBooks Web Connector is configured with longer polling intervals or the target company file is slow to respond.

Passed as a request header — not a query-string value.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of PurchaseOrders where the default limit is 150.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description:
The pagination cursor token used to retrieve the next set of records.

Capture the `nextCursor` from the response JSON and provide it here to continue fetching data.


**The 10-Second Rule:** Due to QuickBooks Desktop architectural requirements, you must request
the next page within **10 seconds** of receiving the previous response.


**Static Cursors:** Unlike some APIs, the cursor remains constant for the entire duration
of the fetch sequence until `hasMore` is `false`.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description:
Filter by one or more unique identifiers (TxnIDs).

Provide a list of strictly matched TxnIDs. This is the most efficient way to retrieve specific records.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.

parameters.name: refNumbers
parameters.description:
Filter by one or more reference numbers.

Returns transactions where the `RefNumber` exactly matches any of the provided values.

parameters.name: refNumberContains
parameters.description:
Filter by reference number (substring match).

Returns transactions where the `RefNumber` contains this string.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.

parameters.name: updatedBefore
parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or before this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **23:59:59** (end of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.

parameters.name: updatedAfter
parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or after this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **00:00:00** (beginning of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.

parameters.name: toTransactionDate
parameters.description: Filter by transaction date (end).

parameters.name: fromTransactionDate
parameters.description: Filter by transaction date (start).

parameters.name: refNumberStartsWith
parameters.description: Filter by starting reference number (startsWith).

parameters.name: refNumberEndsWith
parameters.description: Filter by ending reference number (endsWith).

parameters.name: refNumberFrom
parameters.description:
Reference number range filter (start).

Use this to return transactions whose reference number is alphabetically at or after this value.

parameters.name: refNumberTo
parameters.description:
Reference number range filter (end).

Use this to return transactions whose reference number is alphabetically at or before this value.
If both `refNumberFrom` and `refNumberTo` are specified, `refNumberTo` must be lexicographically higher.

parameters.name: accountIds
parameters.description: Filter by Account IDs

parameters.name: entityIds
parameters.description: Filter by Entity IDs (Customers, Vendors, Employees)

parameters.name: itemIds
parameters.description: Filter by Item IDs

parameters.name: classIds
parameters.description:
Filter by Class IDs

Provide a list of strictly matched ClassIDs.

parameters.name: vendorId
parameters.description: Filter by Vendor ID.

parameters.name: includeLineItems
parameters.description:
Whether to include line items (ExpenseLines, ItemLines, ItemGroupLines) in the response.
Only applies to transaction objects that support line items (Bills, Checks, Invoices, etc.)

parameters.name: includeLinkedTransactions
parameters.description: Whether to include linked transactions in the response.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description:
Limit the response to only these top-level fields. Names must match exactly (case-sensitive QbXML element names e.g. ListIDRet, NameRet, AddressRet, PhoneRet  ).

Passed as a request header — not a query-string value.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description:
The pagination cursor token used to retrieve the next set of records.

Capture the `nextCursor` from the response JSON and provide it here to continue fetching data.


**The 10-Second Rule:** Due to QuickBooks Desktop architectural requirements, you must request
the next page within **10 seconds** of receiving the previous response.


**Static Cursors:** Unlike some APIs, the cursor remains constant for the entire duration
of the fetch sequence until `hasMore` is `false`.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description:
Filter by one or more unique identifiers (TxnIDs).

Provide a list of strictly matched TxnIDs. This is the most efficient way to retrieve specific records.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.

parameters.name: refNumbers
parameters.description:
Filter by one or more reference numbers.

Returns transactions where the `RefNumber` exactly matches any of the provided values.

parameters.name: refNumberContains
parameters.description:
Filter by reference number (substring match).

Returns transactions where the `RefNumber` contains this string.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.

parameters.name: updatedBefore
parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or before this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **23:59:59** (end of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.

parameters.name: updatedAfter
parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or after this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **00:00:00** (beginning of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.

parameters.name: toTransactionDate
parameters.description: Filter by transaction date (end).

parameters.name: fromTransactionDate
parameters.description: Filter by transaction date (start).

parameters.name: refNumberStartsWith
parameters.description: Filter by starting reference number (startsWith).

parameters.name: refNumberEndsWith
parameters.description: Filter by ending reference number (endsWith).

parameters.name: refNumberFrom
parameters.description:
Reference number range filter (start).

Use this to return transactions whose reference number is alphabetically at or after this value.

parameters.name: refNumberTo
parameters.description:
Reference number range filter (end).

Use this to return transactions whose reference number is alphabetically at or before this value.
If both `refNumberFrom` and `refNumberTo` are specified, `refNumberTo` must be lexicographically higher.

parameters.name: accountIds
parameters.description: Filter by Account IDs

parameters.name: entityIds
parameters.description: Filter by Entity IDs (Customers, Vendors, Employees)

parameters.name: itemIds
parameters.description: Filter by Item IDs

parameters.name: classIds
parameters.description:
Filter by Class IDs

Provide a list of strictly matched ClassIDs.

parameters.name: vendorId
parameters.description: Filter by Vendor ID.

parameters.name: includeLineItems
parameters.description:
Whether to include line items (ExpenseLines, ItemLines, ItemGroupLines) in the response.
Only applies to transaction objects that support line items (Bills, Checks, Invoices, etc.)

parameters.name: includeLinkedTransactions
parameters.description: Whether to include linked transactions in the response.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description:
Limit the response to only these top-level fields. Names must match exactly (case-sensitive QbXML element names e.g. ListIDRet, NameRet, AddressRet, PhoneRet  ).

**Note:** The names specified in the list are not parsed, so you must be especially careful to supply valid
names, properly cased. No error is returned in the status code if you specify an invalid name. Notice that if you want to
return custom data or private data extensions, you must specify the DataExtRet element and you must supply the OwnerID set
to either a value of 0 (custom data) or the GUID for the private data.

parameters.name: CurrencyIds
parameters.description: (Optional) Filter by Currency ListID.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of SalesTaxPaymentChecks where the default limit is 150.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description:
The pagination cursor token used to retrieve the next set of records.

Capture the `nextCursor` from the response JSON and provide it here to continue fetching data.


**The 10-Second Rule:** Due to QuickBooks Desktop architectural requirements, you must request
the next page within **10 seconds** of receiving the previous response.


**Static Cursors:** Unlike some APIs, the cursor remains constant for the entire duration
of the fetch sequence until `hasMore` is `false`.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description:
Filter by one or more unique identifiers (TxnIDs).

Provide a list of strictly matched TxnIDs. This is the most efficient way to retrieve specific records.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.

parameters.name: refNumbers
parameters.description:
Filter by one or more reference numbers.

Returns transactions where the `RefNumber` exactly matches any of the provided values.

parameters.name: refNumberContains
parameters.description:
Filter by reference number (substring match).

Returns transactions where the `RefNumber` contains this string.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.

parameters.name: updatedBefore
parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or before this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **23:59:59** (end of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.

parameters.name: updatedAfter
parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or after this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **00:00:00** (beginning of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.

parameters.name: toTransactionDate
parameters.description: Filter by transaction date (end).

parameters.name: fromTransactionDate
parameters.description: Filter by transaction date (start).

parameters.name: refNumberStartsWith
parameters.description: Filter by starting reference number (startsWith).

parameters.name: refNumberEndsWith
parameters.description: Filter by ending reference number (endsWith).

parameters.name: refNumberFrom
parameters.description:
Reference number range filter (start).

Use this to return transactions whose reference number is alphabetically at or after this value.

parameters.name: refNumberTo
parameters.description:
Reference number range filter (end).

Use this to return transactions whose reference number is alphabetically at or before this value.
If both `refNumberFrom` and `refNumberTo` are specified, `refNumberTo` must be lexicographically higher.

parameters.name: accountIds
parameters.description: Filter by Account IDs

parameters.name: entityIds
parameters.description: Filter by Entity IDs (Customers, Vendors, Employees)

parameters.name: itemIds
parameters.description: Filter by Item IDs

parameters.name: classIds
parameters.description:
Filter by Class IDs

Provide a list of strictly matched ClassIDs.

parameters.name: vendorId
parameters.description: Filter by Vendor ID.

parameters.name: includeLineItems
parameters.description:
Whether to include line items (ExpenseLines, ItemLines, ItemGroupLines) in the response.
Only applies to transaction objects that support line items (Bills, Checks, Invoices, etc.)

parameters.name: includeLinkedTransactions
parameters.description: Whether to include linked transactions in the response.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description:
Limit the response to only these top-level fields. Names must match exactly (case-sensitive QbXML element names e.g. ListIDRet, NameRet, AddressRet, PhoneRet  ).

**Note:** The names specified in the list are not parsed, so you must be especially careful to supply valid
names, properly cased. No error is returned in the status code if you specify an invalid name. Notice that if you want to
return custom data or private data extensions, you must specify the DataExtRet element and you must supply the OwnerID set
to either a value of 0 (custom data) or the GUID for the private data.

parameters.name: BankAccountId
parameters.description: Filter by bank account.

parameters.name: EndDate
parameters.description: Filter transactions by date range end.

parameters.name: ModifiedAfter
parameters.description: Filter transactions modified after this date.

parameters.name: PayeeId
parameters.description: Filter by payee entity (vendor).

parameters.name: RefNumber
parameters.description: Filter transactions by reference number (check number).

parameters.name: StartDate
parameters.description: Filter transactions by date range start.

parameters.name: X-Connection-Id
parameters.description:
Identifies which QuickBooks Desktop company file to target.

Accepts three formats:
- **Prefixed ID**: `conn_01965a3f2e7b7000b4c1d2e3f4a5b6c7`
- **Internal GUID**: `3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6`
- **Your external ID**: `acme-corp` (the `externalId` you assigned when creating the connection)

The middleware resolves any of these formats to the correct connection. Required for all QuickBooks resource operations — without it, the API cannot determine which company file to query.

parameters.name: X-Correlation-ID
parameters.description:
A unique identifier for tracing a single request through the entire system.
If not provided by the client, a new one will be generated.
This is not persisted and is used only for logging and monitoring.

parameters.name: X-Nxus-Timeout-Seconds
parameters.description:
Maximum time in seconds to wait for the queued job to be picked up and the response returned from QuickBooks Desktop.

List and streaming query operations accept **1–90** seconds (default **90**). Raise this when the QuickBooks Web Connector is configured with longer polling intervals or the target company file is slow to respond.

Passed as a request header — not a query-string value.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of TimeTrackings where the default limit is 150.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description:
The pagination cursor token used to retrieve the next set of records.

Capture the `nextCursor` from the response JSON and provide it here to continue fetching data.


**The 10-Second Rule:** Due to QuickBooks Desktop architectural requirements, you must request
the next page within **10 seconds** of receiving the previous response.


**Static Cursors:** Unlike some APIs, the cursor remains constant for the entire duration
of the fetch sequence until `hasMore` is `false`.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description:
Filter by one or more unique identifiers (TxnIDs).

Provide a list of strictly matched TxnIDs. This is the most efficient way to retrieve specific records.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.

parameters.name: refNumbers
parameters.description:
Filter by one or more reference numbers.

Returns transactions where the `RefNumber` exactly matches any of the provided values.

parameters.name: refNumberContains
parameters.description:
Filter by reference number (substring match).

Returns transactions where the `RefNumber` contains this string.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.

parameters.name: updatedBefore
parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or before this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **23:59:59** (end of day) is assumed.

parameters.name: refNumberFrom

get.description: Returns a paginated list of Transactions where the default limit is 150.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description:
The pagination cursor token used to retrieve the next set of records.

Capture the `nextCursor` from the response JSON and provide it here to continue fetching data.


**The 10-Second Rule:** Due to QuickBooks Desktop architectural requirements, you must request
the next page within **10 seconds** of receiving the previous response.


**Static Cursors:** Unlike some APIs, the cursor remains constant for the entire duration
of the fetch sequence until `hasMore` is `false`.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description:
Filter by one or more unique identifiers (TxnIDs).

Provide a list of strictly matched TxnIDs. This is the most efficient way to retrieve specific records.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.

parameters.name: refNumbers
parameters.description:
Filter by one or more reference numbers.

Returns transactions where the `RefNumber` exactly matches any of the provided values.

parameters.name: refNumberContains
parameters.description:
Filter by reference number (substring match).

Returns transactions where the `RefNumber` contains this string.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.

parameters.name: updatedBefore
parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or before this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **23:59:59** (end of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.

parameters.name: updatedAfter
parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or after this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **00:00:00** (beginning of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.

parameters.name: toTransactionDate
parameters.description: Filter by transaction date (end).

parameters.name: fromTransactionDate
parameters.description: Filter by transaction date (start).

parameters.name: refNumberStartsWith
parameters.description: Filter by starting reference number (startsWith).

parameters.name: refNumberEndsWith
parameters.description: Filter by ending reference number (endsWith).

parameters.name: refNumberFrom
parameters.description:
Reference number range filter (start).

Use this to return transactions whose reference number is alphabetically at or after this value.

parameters.name: refNumberTo
parameters.description:
Reference number range filter (end).

Use this to return transactions whose reference number is alphabetically at or before this value.
If both `refNumberFrom` and `refNumberTo` are specified, `refNumberTo` must be lexicographically higher.

parameters.name: accountIds
parameters.description: Filter by Account IDs

parameters.name: entityIds
parameters.description: Filter by Entity IDs (Customers, Vendors, Employees)

parameters.name: itemIds
parameters.description: Filter by Item IDs

parameters.name: classIds
parameters.description:
Filter by Class IDs

Provide a list of strictly matched ClassIDs.

parameters.name: vendorId
parameters.description: Filter by Vendor ID.

parameters.name: includeLineItems
parameters.description:
Whether to include line items (ExpenseLines, ItemLines, ItemGroupLines) in the response.
Only applies to transaction objects that support line items (Bills, Checks, Invoices, etc.)

parameters.name: includeLinkedTransactions
parameters.description: Whether to include linked transactions in the response.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description:
Limit the response to only these top-level fields. Names must match exactly (case-sensitive QbXML element names e.g. ListIDRet, NameRet, AddressRet, PhoneRet  ).

**Note:** The names specified in the list are not parsed, so you must be especially careful to supply valid
names, properly cased. No error is returned in the status code if you specify an invalid name. Notice that if you want to
return custom data or private data extensions, you must specify the DataExtRet element and you must supply the OwnerID set
to either a value of 0 (custom data) or the GUID for the private data.

parameters.name: CurrencyIds
parameters.description: Filter by Currency ListIDs.

parameters.name: DetailLevel
parameters.description:
Transaction Detail Level: "all", "transaction_lines_only", "transactions_without_lines"
QBXML maps to: All, AllExceptSummary, SummaryOnly

<value>all</value>
<value>transaction_lines_only</value>
<value>transactions_without_lines</value>

parameters.name: PaymentStatus
parameters.description: Filter by Payment Status: "open", "closed"

parameters.name: PostingStatus
parameters.description: Filter by Posting Status: "posting", "non_posting"

parameters.name: TransactionTypes
parameters.description:
Filter transactions by transaction type.
Available options: all, ar_refund_credit_card, bill, bill_payment_check, bill_payment_credit_card, build_assembly, 
charge, check, credit_card_charge, credit_card_credit, credit_memo, deposit, estimate, inventory_adjustment, invoice, 
item_receipt, journal_entry, liability_adjustment, paycheck, payroll_liability_check, purchase_order, receive_payment, 
sales_order, sales_receipt, sales_tax_payment_check, transfer, vendor_credit, ytd_adjustment

get.description: Returns a paginated list of VendorCredits where the default limit is 150.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description:
The pagination cursor token used to retrieve the next set of records.

Capture the `nextCursor` from the response JSON and provide it here to continue fetching data.


**The 10-Second Rule:** Due to QuickBooks Desktop architectural requirements, you must request
the next page within **10 seconds** of receiving the previous response.


**Static Cursors:** Unlike some APIs, the cursor remains constant for the entire duration
of the fetch sequence until `hasMore` is `false`.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description:
Filter by one or more unique identifiers (TxnIDs).

Provide a list of strictly matched TxnIDs. This is the most efficient way to retrieve specific records.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.

parameters.name: refNumbers
parameters.description:
Filter by one or more reference numbers.

Returns transactions where the `RefNumber` exactly matches any of the provided values.

parameters.name: refNumberContains
parameters.description:
Filter by reference number (substring match).

Returns transactions where the `RefNumber` contains this string.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.

parameters.name: updatedBefore
parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or before this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **23:59:59** (end of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.

parameters.name: updatedAfter
parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or after this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **00:00:00** (beginning of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.

parameters.name: toTransactionDate
parameters.description: Filter by transaction date (end).

parameters.name: fromTransactionDate
parameters.description: Filter by transaction date (start).

parameters.name: refNumberStartsWith
parameters.description: Filter by starting reference number (startsWith).

parameters.name: refNumberEndsWith
parameters.description: Filter by ending reference number (endsWith).

parameters.name: refNumberFrom
parameters.description:
Reference number range filter (start).

Use this to return transactions whose reference number is alphabetically at or after this value.

parameters.name: refNumberTo
parameters.description:
Reference number range filter (end).

Use this to return transactions whose reference number is alphabetically at or before this value.
If both `refNumberFrom` and `refNumberTo` are specified, `refNumberTo` must be lexicographically higher.

parameters.name: accountIds
parameters.description: Filter by Account IDs

parameters.name: entityIds
parameters.description: Filter by Entity IDs (Customers, Vendors, Employees)

parameters.name: itemIds
parameters.description: Filter by Item IDs

parameters.name: classIds
parameters.description:
Filter by Class IDs

Provide a list of strictly matched ClassIDs.

parameters.name: vendorId
parameters.description: Filter by Vendor ID.

parameters.name: includeLineItems
parameters.description:
Whether to include line items (ExpenseLines, ItemLines, ItemGroupLines) in the response.
Only applies to transaction objects that support line items (Bills, Checks, Invoices, etc.)

parameters.name: includeLinkedTransactions
parameters.description: Whether to include linked transactions in the response.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description:
Limit the response to only these top-level fields. Names must match exactly (case-sensitive QbXML element names e.g. ListIDRet, NameRet, AddressRet, PhoneRet  ).

**Note:** The names specified in the list are not parsed, so you must be especially careful to supply valid
names, properly cased. No error is returned in the status code if you specify an invalid name. Notice that if you want to
return custom data or private data extensions, you must specify the DataExtRet element and you must supply the OwnerID set
to either a value of 0 (custom data) or the GUID for the private data.

Passed as a request header — not a query-string value.
