get.description: Returns a list of Accounts where the default limit is 500. **Note: Cursor-based pagination is NOT supported for this resource, so all available records (up to the limit) will be returned in a single response.**

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description:
The pagination cursor token used to retrieve the next set of records.

Capture the `nextCursor` from the response JSON and provide it here to continue fetching data.


**The 10-Second Rule:** Due to QuickBooks Desktop architectural requirements, you must request
the next page within **10 seconds** of receiving the previous response.


**Static Cursors:** Unlike some APIs, the cursor remains constant for the entire duration
of the fetch sequence until `hasMore` is `false`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return for this request.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description:
Filter by one or more unique identifiers (ListIDs).

Provide a list of strictly matched ListIDs. This is the most efficient way to retrieve specific records.

parameters.name: fullNames
parameters.description:
Filter by one or more exact full names.

Returns records whose `FullName` exactly matches any of the provided strings.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.

parameters.name: activeStatus
parameters.description: Shortcut for Filters.ActiveStatus - Filter by active status enum: ActiveOnly InactiveOnly ALL

parameters.name: updatedBefore
parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or before this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **23:59:59** (end of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.

parameters.name: updatedAfter
parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or after this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **00:00:00** (beginning of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.

parameters.name: nameContains
parameters.description:
Filter by name (substring match).

Matches records where the `FullName` contains this string.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.

parameters.name: nameStartsWith
parameters.description:
Return records whose name starts with this value.

Matches records where the `FullName` begins with this string.
Example: Searching "Mac" returns "MacPherson", "MacGyver", etc.

parameters.name: nameEndsWith
parameters.description:
Return records whose name ends with this value.

Matches records where the `FullName` finishes with this string.
Example: Searching "kitchen" returns "John's Kitchen", "Central Kitchen", etc.

parameters.name: nameFrom
parameters.description:
Name range filter (start).

Returns records whose name is alphabetically at or after this value.

parameters.name: nameTo
parameters.description:
Name range filter (end).

Returns records whose name is alphabetically at or before this value.
If both `nameFrom` and `nameTo` are specified, `nameTo` must be lexicographically higher.

parameters.name: IncludeRetElementList
parameters.description:
Limit the response to only these top-level fields. Names must match exactly (case-sensitive QbXML element names e.g. ListIDRet, NameRet, AddressRet, PhoneRet  ).

**Note:** The names specified in the list are not parsed, so you must be especially careful to supply valid
names, properly cased. No error is returned in the status code if you specify an invalid name. Notice that if you want to
return custom data or private data extensions, you must specify the DataExtRet element and you must supply the OwnerID set
to either a value of 0 (custom data) or the GUID for the private data.
<example>["ListIDRet", "NameRet", "AddressRet", "PhoneRet"]</example>

parameters.name: accountType
parameters.description:
Optional: Filter by account type (e.g., Bank, AccountsReceivable, Expense, Income, etc.)
Binds from query parameter: ?accountType=Bank

parameters.name: ownerIds
parameters.description: Optional: Filter by OwnerID (GUIDs).

get.description: Returns a list of BillingRates where the default limit is 500. **Note: Cursor-based pagination is NOT supported for this resource, so all available records (up to the limit) will be returned in a single response.**

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description:
The pagination cursor token used to retrieve the next set of records.

Capture the `nextCursor` from the response JSON and provide it here to continue fetching data.


**The 10-Second Rule:** Due to QuickBooks Desktop architectural requirements, you must request
the next page within **10 seconds** of receiving the previous response.


**Static Cursors:** Unlike some APIs, the cursor remains constant for the entire duration
of the fetch sequence until `hasMore` is `false`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return for this request.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description:
Filter by one or more unique identifiers (ListIDs).

Provide a list of strictly matched ListIDs. This is the most efficient way to retrieve specific records.

parameters.name: fullNames
parameters.description:
Filter by one or more exact full names.

Returns records whose `FullName` exactly matches any of the provided strings.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.

parameters.name: activeStatus
parameters.description: Shortcut for Filters.ActiveStatus - Filter by active status enum: ActiveOnly InactiveOnly ALL

parameters.name: updatedBefore
parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or before this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **23:59:59** (end of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.

parameters.name: updatedAfter
parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or after this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **00:00:00** (beginning of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.

parameters.name: nameContains
parameters.description:
Filter by name (substring match).

Matches records where the `FullName` contains this string.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.

parameters.name: nameStartsWith
parameters.description:
Return records whose name starts with this value.

Matches records where the `FullName` begins with this string.
Example: Searching "Mac" returns "MacPherson", "MacGyver", etc.

parameters.name: nameEndsWith
parameters.description:
Return records whose name ends with this value.

Matches records where the `FullName` finishes with this string.
Example: Searching "kitchen" returns "John's Kitchen", "Central Kitchen", etc.

parameters.name: nameFrom
parameters.description:
Name range filter (start).

Returns records whose name is alphabetically at or after this value.

parameters.name: nameTo
parameters.description:
Name range filter (end).

Returns records whose name is alphabetically at or before this value.
If both `nameFrom` and `nameTo` are specified, `nameTo` must be lexicographically higher.

parameters.name: IncludeRetElementList
parameters.description:
Limit the response to only these top-level fields. Names must match exactly (case-sensitive QbXML element names e.g. ListIDRet, NameRet, AddressRet, PhoneRet  ).

**Note:** The names specified in the list are not parsed, so you must be especially careful to supply valid
names, properly cased. No error is returned in the status code if you specify an invalid name. Notice that if you want to
return custom data or private data extensions, you must specify the DataExtRet element and you must supply the OwnerID set
to either a value of 0 (custom data) or the GUID for the private data.
<example>["ListIDRet", "NameRet", "AddressRet", "PhoneRet"]</example>

parameters.name: ItemFilter
parameters.description: (Optional) Filter by the service item referenced in the billing rate (ListID or FullName).

get.description: Returns a paginated list of QbdClasss where the default limit is 150.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description:
The pagination cursor token used to retrieve the next set of records.

Capture the `nextCursor` from the response JSON and provide it here to continue fetching data.


**The 10-Second Rule:** Due to QuickBooks Desktop architectural requirements, you must request
the next page within **10 seconds** of receiving the previous response.


**Static Cursors:** Unlike some APIs, the cursor remains constant for the entire duration
of the fetch sequence until `hasMore` is `false`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description:
Filter by one or more unique identifiers (ListIDs).

Provide a list of strictly matched ListIDs. This is the most efficient way to retrieve specific records.

parameters.name: fullNames
parameters.description:
Filter by one or more exact full names.

Returns records whose `FullName` exactly matches any of the provided strings.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.

parameters.name: activeStatus
parameters.description: Shortcut for Filters.ActiveStatus - Filter by active status enum: ActiveOnly InactiveOnly ALL

parameters.name: updatedBefore
parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or before this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **23:59:59** (end of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.

parameters.name: updatedAfter
parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or after this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **00:00:00** (beginning of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.

parameters.name: nameContains
parameters.description:
Filter by name (substring match).

Matches records where the `FullName` contains this string.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.

parameters.name: nameStartsWith
parameters.description:
Return records whose name starts with this value.

Matches records where the `FullName` begins with this string.
Example: Searching "Mac" returns "MacPherson", "MacGyver", etc.

parameters.name: nameEndsWith
parameters.description:
Return records whose name ends with this value.

Matches records where the `FullName` finishes with this string.
Example: Searching "kitchen" returns "John's Kitchen", "Central Kitchen", etc.

parameters.name: nameFrom
parameters.description:
Name range filter (start).

Returns records whose name is alphabetically at or after this value.

parameters.name: nameTo
parameters.description:
Name range filter (end).

Returns records whose name is alphabetically at or before this value.
If both `nameFrom` and `nameTo` are specified, `nameTo` must be lexicographically higher.

parameters.name: IncludeRetElementList
parameters.description:
Limit the response to only these top-level fields. Names must match exactly (case-sensitive QbXML element names e.g. ListIDRet, NameRet, AddressRet, PhoneRet  ).

**Note:** The names specified in the list are not parsed, so you must be especially careful to supply valid
names, properly cased. No error is returned in the status code if you specify an invalid name. Notice that if you want to
return custom data or private data extensions, you must specify the DataExtRet element and you must supply the OwnerID set
to either a value of 0 (custom data) or the GUID for the private data.
<example>["ListIDRet", "NameRet", "AddressRet", "PhoneRet"]</example>

parameters.name: X-Connection-Id
parameters.description:

Accepts three formats:
- **Prefixed ID**: `conn_01965a3f2e7b7000b4c1d2e3f4a5b6c7`

- **Your external ID**: `acme-corp` (the `externalId` you assigned when creating the connection)

The middleware resolves any of these formats to the correct connection. Required for all QuickBooks resource operations — without it, the API cannot determine which company file to query.

parameters.name: X-Nxus-Timeout-Seconds
parameters.description:
Maximum time in seconds to wait for the queued job to be picked up and the response returned from QuickBooks Desktop.

Create / update / delete and single-entity retrieval operations accept **1–120** seconds (default **120**). Raise this when the QuickBooks Web Connector is configured with longer polling intervals or the target company file is slow to respond.

Passed as a request header — not a query-string value.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description:
The pagination cursor token used to retrieve the next set of records.

Capture the `nextCursor` from the response JSON and provide it here to continue fetching data.


**The 10-Second Rule:** Due to QuickBooks Desktop architectural requirements, you must request
the next page within **10 seconds** of receiving the previous response.


**Static Cursors:** Unlike some APIs, the cursor remains constant for the entire duration
of the fetch sequence until `hasMore` is `false`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description:
Filter by one or more unique identifiers (ListIDs).

Provide a list of strictly matched ListIDs. This is the most efficient way to retrieve specific records.

parameters.name: fullNames
parameters.description:
Filter by one or more exact full names.

Returns records whose `FullName` exactly matches any of the provided strings.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.

parameters.name: activeStatus
parameters.description: Shortcut for Filters.ActiveStatus - Filter by active status enum: ActiveOnly InactiveOnly ALL

parameters.name: updatedBefore
parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or before this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **23:59:59** (end of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.

parameters.name: updatedAfter
parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or after this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **00:00:00** (beginning of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.

parameters.name: nameContains
parameters.description:
Filter by name (substring match).

Matches records where the `FullName` contains this string.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.

parameters.name: nameStartsWith
parameters.description:
Return records whose name starts with this value.

Matches records where the `FullName` begins with this string.
Example: Searching "Mac" returns "MacPherson", "MacGyver", etc.

parameters.name: nameEndsWith
parameters.description:
Return records whose name ends with this value.

Matches records where the `FullName` finishes with this string.
Example: Searching "kitchen" returns "John's Kitchen", "Central Kitchen", etc.

parameters.name: nameFrom
parameters.description:
Name range filter (start).

Returns records whose name is alphabetically at or after this value.

parameters.name: nameTo
parameters.description:
Name range filter (end).

Returns records whose name is alphabetically at or before this value.
If both `nameFrom` and `nameTo` are specified, `nameTo` must be lexicographically higher.

parameters.name: IncludeRetElementList
parameters.description:
Limit the response to only these top-level fields. Names must match exactly (case-sensitive QbXML element names e.g. ListIDRet, NameRet, AddressRet, PhoneRet  ).

**Note:** The names specified in the list are not parsed, so you must be especially careful to supply valid
names, properly cased. No error is returned in the status code if you specify an invalid name. Notice that if you want to
return custom data or private data extensions, you must specify the DataExtRet element and you must supply the OwnerID set
to either a value of 0 (custom data) or the GUID for the private data.
<example>["ListIDRet", "NameRet", "AddressRet", "PhoneRet"]</example>

get.description: Returns a paginated list of Customers where the default limit is 150.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description:
The pagination cursor token used to retrieve the next set of records.

Capture the `nextCursor` from the response JSON and provide it here to continue fetching data.


**The 10-Second Rule:** Due to QuickBooks Desktop architectural requirements, you must request
the next page within **10 seconds** of receiving the previous response.


**Static Cursors:** Unlike some APIs, the cursor remains constant for the entire duration
of the fetch sequence until `hasMore` is `false`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description:
Filter by one or more unique identifiers (ListIDs).

Provide a list of strictly matched ListIDs. This is the most efficient way to retrieve specific records.

parameters.name: fullNames
parameters.description:
Filter by one or more exact full names.

Returns records whose `FullName` exactly matches any of the provided strings.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.

parameters.name: activeStatus
parameters.description: Shortcut for Filters.ActiveStatus - Filter by active status enum: ActiveOnly InactiveOnly ALL

parameters.name: updatedBefore
parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or before this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **23:59:59** (end of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.

parameters.name: updatedAfter
parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or after this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **00:00:00** (beginning of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.

parameters.name: nameContains
parameters.description:
Filter by name (substring match).

Matches records where the `FullName` contains this string.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.

parameters.name: nameStartsWith
parameters.description:
Return records whose name starts with this value.

Matches records where the `FullName` begins with this string.
Example: Searching "Mac" returns "MacPherson", "MacGyver", etc.

parameters.name: nameEndsWith
parameters.description:
Return records whose name ends with this value.

Matches records where the `FullName` finishes with this string.
Example: Searching "kitchen" returns "John's Kitchen", "Central Kitchen", etc.

parameters.name: nameFrom
parameters.description:
Name range filter (start).

Returns records whose name is alphabetically at or after this value.

parameters.name: nameTo
parameters.description:
Name range filter (end).

Returns records whose name is alphabetically at or before this value.
If both `nameFrom` and `nameTo` are specified, `nameTo` must be lexicographically higher.

parameters.name: IncludeRetElementList
parameters.description:
Limit the response to only these top-level fields. Names must match exactly (case-sensitive QbXML element names e.g. ListIDRet, NameRet, AddressRet, PhoneRet  ).

**Note:** The names specified in the list are not parsed, so you must be especially careful to supply valid
names, properly cased. No error is returned in the status code if you specify an invalid name. Notice that if you want to
return custom data or private data extensions, you must specify the DataExtRet element and you must supply the OwnerID set
to either a value of 0 (custom data) or the GUID for the private data.
<example>["ListIDRet", "NameRet", "AddressRet", "PhoneRet"]</example>

parameters.name: classIds
parameters.description: Filter by specific Class IDs.

parameters.name: excludeShipToAddress
parameters.description:
PERFORMANCE OPTIMIZATION: Exclude ShipToAddress data from the response.
QuickBooks SDK strongly recommends excluding ship addresses unless specifically needed,
as it significantly improves query performance.
Default: true (ship addresses excluded for better performance)
init to false if you need shipping address data.
Example: ?excludeShipToAddress=false

parameters.name: JobStatus
parameters.description: Optional: Filter by job status (customer-specific filter)

parameters.name: totalBalance
parameters.description:
Filter for customers whose totalBalance equals this amount.
Mutually exclusive with other totalBalance filters.

parameters.name: totalBalanceGreaterThan
parameters.description:
Filter for customers whose totalBalance is greater than this amount.
Mutually exclusive with other totalBalance filters.

parameters.name: totalBalanceGreaterThanOrEqualTo
parameters.description:
Filter for customers whose totalBalance is greater than or equal to this amount.
Mutually exclusive with other totalBalance filters.

parameters.name: totalBalanceLessThan
parameters.description:
Filter for customers whose totalBalance is less than this amount.
Mutually exclusive with other totalBalance filters.

parameters.name: totalBalanceLessThanOrEqualTo
parameters.description:
Filter for customers whose totalBalance is less than or equal to this amount.
Mutually exclusive with other totalBalance filters.

parameters.name: X-Connection-Id
parameters.description:
Identifies which QuickBooks Desktop company file to target.

Accepts three formats:
- **Prefixed ID**: `conn_01965a3f2e7b7000b4c1d2e3f4a5b6c7`
- **Internal GUID**: `3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6`
- **Your external ID**: `acme-corp` (the `externalId` you assigned when creating the connection)

The middleware resolves any of these formats to the correct connection. Required for all QuickBooks resource operations — without it, the API cannot determine which company file to query.

parameters.name: X-Correlation-ID
parameters.description:
A unique identifier for tracing a single request through the entire system.
If not provided by the client, a new one will be generated.
This is not persisted and is used only for logging and monitoring.

parameters.name: X-Nxus-Timeout-Seconds
parameters.description:

get.description: Returns a paginated list of DateDrivenTerms where the default limit is 150.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description:
The pagination cursor token used to retrieve the next set of records.

Capture the `nextCursor` from the response JSON and provide it here to continue fetching data.


**The 10-Second Rule:** Due to QuickBooks Desktop architectural requirements, you must request
the next page within **10 seconds** of receiving the previous response.


**Static Cursors:** Unlike some APIs, the cursor remains constant for the entire duration
of the fetch sequence until `hasMore` is `false`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description:
Filter by one or more unique identifiers (ListIDs).

Provide a list of strictly matched ListIDs. This is the most efficient way to retrieve specific records.

parameters.name: fullNames
parameters.description:
Filter by one or more exact full names.

Returns records whose `FullName` exactly matches any of the provided strings.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.

parameters.name: activeStatus
parameters.description: Shortcut for Filters.ActiveStatus - Filter by active status enum: ActiveOnly InactiveOnly ALL

parameters.name: updatedBefore
parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or before this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **23:59:59** (end of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.

parameters.name: updatedAfter
parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or after this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **00:00:00** (beginning of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.

parameters.name: nameContains
parameters.description:
Filter by name (substring match).

Matches records where the `FullName` contains this string.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.

parameters.name: nameStartsWith
parameters.description:
Return records whose name starts with this value.

Matches records where the `FullName` begins with this string.
Example: Searching "Mac" returns "MacPherson", "MacGyver", etc.

parameters.name: nameEndsWith
parameters.description:
Return records whose name ends with this value.

Matches records where the `FullName` finishes with this string.
Example: Searching "kitchen" returns "John's Kitchen", "Central Kitchen", etc.

parameters.name: nameFrom
parameters.description:
Name range filter (start).

Returns records whose name is alphabetically at or after this value.

parameters.name: nameTo
parameters.description:
Name range filter (end).

Returns records whose name is alphabetically at or before this value.
If both `nameFrom` and `nameTo` are specified, `nameTo` must be lexicographically higher.

parameters.name: IncludeRetElementList
parameters.description:
Limit the response to only these top-level fields. Names must match exactly (case-sensitive QbXML element names e.g. ListIDRet, NameRet, AddressRet, PhoneRet  ).

**Note:** The names specified in the list are not parsed, so you must be especially careful to supply valid
names, properly cased. No error is returned in the status code if you specify an invalid name. Notice that if you want to
return custom data or private data extensions, you must specify the DataExtRet element and you must supply the OwnerID set
to either a value of 0 (custom data) or the GUID for the private data.
<example>["ListIDRet", "NameRet", "AddressRet", "PhoneRet"]</example>

parameters.name: X-Connection-Id
parameters.description:
Identifies which QuickBooks Desktop company file to target.

Accepts three formats:
- **Prefixed ID**: `conn_01965a3f2e7b7000b4c1d2e3f4a5b6c7`
- **Internal GUID**: `3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6`

The middleware resolves any of these formats to the correct connection. Required for all QuickBooks resource operations — without it, the API cannot determine which company file to query.

parameters.description:

If not provided by the client, a new one will be generated.
This is not persisted and is used only for logging and monitoring.

parameters.name: X-Connection-Id
parameters.description:
Identifies which QuickBooks Desktop company file to target.

Accepts three formats:
- **Prefixed ID**: `conn_01965a3f2e7b7000b4c1d2e3f4a5b6c7`
- **Internal GUID**: `3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6`
- **Your external ID**: `acme-corp` (the `externalId` you assigned when creating the connection)

The middleware resolves any of these formats to the correct connection. Required for all QuickBooks resource operations — without it, the API cannot determine which company file to query.

parameters.name: X-Nxus-Timeout-Seconds
parameters.description:
Maximum time in seconds to wait for the queued job to be picked up and the response returned from QuickBooks Desktop.

Create / update / delete and single-entity retrieval operations accept **1–120** seconds (default **120**). Raise this when the QuickBooks Web Connector is configured with longer polling intervals or the target company file is slow to respond.

Passed as a request header — not a query-string value.

get.description: Returns a list of Employees where the default limit is 500. **Note: Cursor-based pagination is NOT supported for this resource, so all available records (up to the limit) will be returned in a single response.**

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description:
The pagination cursor token used to retrieve the next set of records.

Capture the `nextCursor` from the response JSON and provide it here to continue fetching data.


**The 10-Second Rule:** Due to QuickBooks Desktop architectural requirements, you must request
the next page within **10 seconds** of receiving the previous response.


**Static Cursors:** Unlike some APIs, the cursor remains constant for the entire duration
of the fetch sequence until `hasMore` is `false`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return for this request.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description:
Filter by one or more unique identifiers (ListIDs).

Provide a list of strictly matched ListIDs. This is the most efficient way to retrieve specific records.

parameters.name: fullNames
parameters.description:
Filter by one or more exact full names.

Returns records whose `FullName` exactly matches any of the provided strings.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.

parameters.name: activeStatus
parameters.description: Shortcut for Filters.ActiveStatus - Filter by active status enum: ActiveOnly InactiveOnly ALL

parameters.name: updatedBefore
parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or before this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **23:59:59** (end of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.

parameters.name: updatedAfter
parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or after this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **00:00:00** (beginning of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.

parameters.name: nameContains
parameters.description:
Filter by name (substring match).

Matches records where the `FullName` contains this string.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.

parameters.name: nameStartsWith
parameters.description:
Return records whose name starts with this value.

Matches records where the `FullName` begins with this string.
Example: Searching "Mac" returns "MacPherson", "MacGyver", etc.

parameters.name: nameEndsWith
parameters.description:
Return records whose name ends with this value.

Matches records where the `FullName` finishes with this string.
Example: Searching "kitchen" returns "John's Kitchen", "Central Kitchen", etc.

parameters.name: nameFrom
parameters.description:
Name range filter (start).

Returns records whose name is alphabetically at or after this value.

parameters.name: nameTo
parameters.description:
Name range filter (end).

Returns records whose name is alphabetically at or before this value.
If both `nameFrom` and `nameTo` are specified, `nameTo` must be lexicographically higher.

parameters.name: IncludeRetElementList
parameters.description:
Limit the response to only these top-level fields. Names must match exactly (case-sensitive QbXML element names e.g. ListIDRet, NameRet, AddressRet, PhoneRet  ).

**Note:** The names specified in the list are not parsed, so you must be especially careful to supply valid
names, properly cased. No error is returned in the status code if you specify an invalid name. Notice that if you want to
return custom data or private data extensions, you must specify the DataExtRet element and you must supply the OwnerID set
to either a value of 0 (custom data) or the GUID for the private data.
<example>["ListIDRet", "NameRet", "AddressRet", "PhoneRet"]</example>

parameters.name: X-Connection-Id
parameters.description:
Identifies which QuickBooks Desktop company file to target.

Accepts three formats:
- **Prefixed ID**: `conn_01965a3f2e7b7000b4c1d2e3f4a5b6c7`
- **Internal GUID**: `3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6`
- **Your external ID**: `acme-corp` (the `externalId` you assigned when creating the connection)

The middleware resolves any of these formats to the correct connection. Required for all QuickBooks resource operations — without it, the API cannot determine which company file to query.

parameters.name: X-Correlation-ID
parameters.description:
A unique identifier for tracing a single request through the entire system.
If not provided by the client, a new one will be generated.
This is not persisted and is used only for logging and monitoring.

parameters.name: X-Nxus-Timeout-Seconds
parameters.description:
Maximum time in seconds to wait for the queued job to be picked up and the response returned from QuickBooks Desktop.

List and streaming query operations accept **1–90** seconds (default **90**). Raise this when the QuickBooks Web Connector is configured with longer polling intervals or the target company file is slow to respond.

Passed as a request header — not a query-string value.

Passed as a request header — not a query-string value.

get.description: Returns a list of InventorySites where the default limit is 500. **Note: Cursor-based pagination is NOT supported for this resource, so all available records (up to the limit) will be returned in a single response.**

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description:
The pagination cursor token used to retrieve the next set of records.

Capture the `nextCursor` from the response JSON and provide it here to continue fetching data.


**The 10-Second Rule:** Due to QuickBooks Desktop architectural requirements, you must request
the next page within **10 seconds** of receiving the previous response.


**Static Cursors:** Unlike some APIs, the cursor remains constant for the entire duration
of the fetch sequence until `hasMore` is `false`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return for this request.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description:
Filter by one or more unique identifiers (ListIDs).

Provide a list of strictly matched ListIDs. This is the most efficient way to retrieve specific records.

parameters.name: fullNames
parameters.description:
Filter by one or more exact full names.

Returns records whose `FullName` exactly matches any of the provided strings.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.

parameters.name: activeStatus
parameters.description: Shortcut for Filters.ActiveStatus - Filter by active status enum: ActiveOnly InactiveOnly ALL

parameters.name: updatedBefore
parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or before this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **23:59:59** (end of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.

parameters.name: updatedAfter
parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or after this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **00:00:00** (beginning of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.

parameters.name: nameContains
parameters.description:
Filter by name (substring match).

Matches records where the `FullName` contains this string.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.

parameters.name: nameStartsWith
parameters.description:
Return records whose name starts with this value.

Matches records where the `FullName` begins with this string.
Example: Searching "Mac" returns "MacPherson", "MacGyver", etc.

parameters.name: nameEndsWith
parameters.description:
Return records whose name ends with this value.

Matches records where the `FullName` finishes with this string.
Example: Searching "kitchen" returns "John's Kitchen", "Central Kitchen", etc.

parameters.name: nameFrom
parameters.description:
Name range filter (start).

Returns records whose name is alphabetically at or after this value.

parameters.name: nameTo
parameters.description:
Name range filter (end).

Returns records whose name is alphabetically at or before this value.
If both `nameFrom` and `nameTo` are specified, `nameTo` must be lexicographically higher.

parameters.name: IncludeRetElementList
parameters.description:
Limit the response to only these top-level fields. Names must match exactly (case-sensitive QbXML element names e.g. ListIDRet, NameRet, AddressRet, PhoneRet  ).

**Note:** The names specified in the list are not parsed, so you must be especially careful to supply valid
names, properly cased. No error is returned in the status code if you specify an invalid name. Notice that if you want to
return custom data or private data extensions, you must specify the DataExtRet element and you must supply the OwnerID set
to either a value of 0 (custom data) or the GUID for the private data.
<example>["ListIDRet", "NameRet", "AddressRet", "PhoneRet"]</example>

parameters.name: X-Connection-Id
parameters.description:
Identifies which QuickBooks Desktop company file to target.

Accepts three formats:
- **Prefixed ID**: `conn_01965a3f2e7b7000b4c1d2e3f4a5b6c7`
- **Internal GUID**: `3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6`
- **Your external ID**: `acme-corp` (the `externalId` you assigned when creating the connection)

The middleware resolves any of these formats to the correct connection. Required for all QuickBooks resource operations — without it, the API cannot determine which company file to query.

parameters.name: X-Correlation-ID
parameters.description:
A unique identifier for tracing a single request through the entire system.
If not provided by the client, a new one will be generated.
This is not persisted and is used only for logging and monitoring.

parameters.name: X-Nxus-Timeout-Seconds

get.description: Returns a list of OtherNames where the default limit is 500. **Note: Cursor-based pagination is NOT supported for this resource, so all available records (up to the limit) will be returned in a single response.**

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description:
The pagination cursor token used to retrieve the next set of records.

Capture the `nextCursor` from the response JSON and provide it here to continue fetching data.


**The 10-Second Rule:** Due to QuickBooks Desktop architectural requirements, you must request
the next page within **10 seconds** of receiving the previous response.


**Static Cursors:** Unlike some APIs, the cursor remains constant for the entire duration
of the fetch sequence until `hasMore` is `false`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return for this request.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description:
Filter by one or more unique identifiers (ListIDs).

Provide a list of strictly matched ListIDs. This is the most efficient way to retrieve specific records.

parameters.name: fullNames
parameters.description:
Filter by one or more exact full names.

Returns records whose `FullName` exactly matches any of the provided strings.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.

parameters.name: activeStatus
parameters.description: Shortcut for Filters.ActiveStatus - Filter by active status enum: ActiveOnly InactiveOnly ALL

parameters.name: updatedBefore
parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or before this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **23:59:59** (end of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.

parameters.name: updatedAfter
parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or after this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **00:00:00** (beginning of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.

parameters.name: nameContains
parameters.description:
Filter by name (substring match).

Matches records where the `FullName` contains this string.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.

parameters.name: nameStartsWith
parameters.description:
Return records whose name starts with this value.

Matches records where the `FullName` begins with this string.
Example: Searching "Mac" returns "MacPherson", "MacGyver", etc.

parameters.name: nameEndsWith
parameters.description:
Return records whose name ends with this value.

Matches records where the `FullName` finishes with this string.
Example: Searching "kitchen" returns "John's Kitchen", "Central Kitchen", etc.

parameters.name: nameFrom
parameters.description:
Name range filter (start).

Returns records whose name is alphabetically at or after this value.

parameters.name: nameTo
parameters.description:
Name range filter (end).

Returns records whose name is alphabetically at or before this value.
If both `nameFrom` and `nameTo` are specified, `nameTo` must be lexicographically higher.

parameters.name: IncludeRetElementList
parameters.description:
Limit the response to only these top-level fields. Names must match exactly (case-sensitive QbXML element names e.g. ListIDRet, NameRet, AddressRet, PhoneRet  ).

**Note:** The names specified in the list are not parsed, so you must be especially careful to supply valid
names, properly cased. No error is returned in the status code if you specify an invalid name. Notice that if you want to
return custom data or private data extensions, you must specify the DataExtRet element and you must supply the OwnerID set
to either a value of 0 (custom data) or the GUID for the private data.
<example>["ListIDRet", "NameRet", "AddressRet", "PhoneRet"]</example>

get.description: Returns a list of PaymentMethods where the default limit is 500. **Note: Cursor-based pagination is NOT supported for this resource, so all available records (up to the limit) will be returned in a single response.**

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description:
The pagination cursor token used to retrieve the next set of records.

Capture the `nextCursor` from the response JSON and provide it here to continue fetching data.


**The 10-Second Rule:** Due to QuickBooks Desktop architectural requirements, you must request
the next page within **10 seconds** of receiving the previous response.


**Static Cursors:** Unlike some APIs, the cursor remains constant for the entire duration
of the fetch sequence until `hasMore` is `false`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return for this request.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description:
Filter by one or more unique identifiers (ListIDs).

Provide a list of strictly matched ListIDs. This is the most efficient way to retrieve specific records.

parameters.name: fullNames
parameters.description:
Filter by one or more exact full names.

Returns records whose `FullName` exactly matches any of the provided strings.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.

parameters.name: activeStatus
parameters.description: Shortcut for Filters.ActiveStatus - Filter by active status enum: ActiveOnly InactiveOnly ALL

parameters.name: updatedBefore
parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or before this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **23:59:59** (end of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.

parameters.name: updatedAfter
parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or after this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **00:00:00** (beginning of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.

parameters.name: nameContains
parameters.description:
Filter by name (substring match).

Matches records where the `FullName` contains this string.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.

parameters.name: nameStartsWith
parameters.description:
Return records whose name starts with this value.

Matches records where the `FullName` begins with this string.
Example: Searching "Mac" returns "MacPherson", "MacGyver", etc.

parameters.name: nameEndsWith
parameters.description:
Return records whose name ends with this value.

Matches records where the `FullName` finishes with this string.
Example: Searching "kitchen" returns "John's Kitchen", "Central Kitchen", etc.

parameters.name: nameFrom
parameters.description:
Name range filter (start).

Returns records whose name is alphabetically at or after this value.

parameters.name: nameTo
parameters.description:
Name range filter (end).

Returns records whose name is alphabetically at or before this value.
If both `nameFrom` and `nameTo` are specified, `nameTo` must be lexicographically higher.

parameters.name: IncludeRetElementList
parameters.description:
Limit the response to only these top-level fields. Names must match exactly (case-sensitive QbXML element names e.g. ListIDRet, NameRet, AddressRet, PhoneRet  ).

**Note:** The names specified in the list are not parsed, so you must be especially careful to supply valid
names, properly cased. No error is returned in the status code if you specify an invalid name. Notice that if you want to
return custom data or private data extensions, you must specify the DataExtRet element and you must supply the OwnerID set
to either a value of 0 (custom data) or the GUID for the private data.
<example>["ListIDRet", "NameRet", "AddressRet", "PhoneRet"]</example>

parameters.name: PaymentMethodType
parameters.description:
(Optional) Filter by type. 
Valid values: american_express, cash, check, debit_card, discover, e_check, gift_card, master_card, other, other_credit_card, visa.

parameters.name: X-Connection-Id
parameters.description:
Identifies which QuickBooks Desktop company file to target.

Accepts three formats:
- **Prefixed ID**: `conn_01965a3f2e7b7000b4c1d2e3f4a5b6c7`
- **Internal GUID**: `3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6`
- **Your external ID**: `acme-corp` (the `externalId` you assigned when creating the connection)

The middleware resolves any of these formats to the correct connection. Required for all QuickBooks resource operations — without it, the API cannot determine which company file to query.

parameters.name: X-Correlation-ID
parameters.description:
A unique identifier for tracing a single request through the entire system.
If not provided by the client, a new one will be generated.
This is not persisted and is used only for logging and monitoring.

parameters.name: X-Nxus-Timeout-Seconds
parameters.description:
Maximum time in seconds to wait for the queued job to be picked up and the response returned from QuickBooks Desktop.

List and streaming query operations accept **1–90** seconds (default **90**). Raise this when the QuickBooks Web Connector is configured with longer polling intervals or the target company file is slow to respond.

Passed as a request header — not a query-string value.

get.description: Returns a list of PriceLevels where the default limit is 500. **Note: Cursor-based pagination is NOT supported for this resource, so all available records (up to the limit) will be returned in a single response.**

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description:
The pagination cursor token used to retrieve the next set of records.

Capture the `nextCursor` from the response JSON and provide it here to continue fetching data.


**The 10-Second Rule:** Due to QuickBooks Desktop architectural requirements, you must request
the next page within **10 seconds** of receiving the previous response.


**Static Cursors:** Unlike some APIs, the cursor remains constant for the entire duration
of the fetch sequence until `hasMore` is `false`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return for this request.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description:
Filter by one or more unique identifiers (ListIDs).

Provide a list of strictly matched ListIDs. This is the most efficient way to retrieve specific records.

parameters.name: fullNames
parameters.description:
Filter by one or more exact full names.

Returns records whose `FullName` exactly matches any of the provided strings.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.

parameters.name: activeStatus
parameters.description: Shortcut for Filters.ActiveStatus - Filter by active status enum: ActiveOnly InactiveOnly ALL

parameters.name: updatedBefore
parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or before this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **23:59:59** (end of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.

parameters.name: updatedAfter
parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or after this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **00:00:00** (beginning of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.

parameters.name: nameContains
parameters.description:
Filter by name (substring match).

Matches records where the `FullName` contains this string.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.

parameters.name: nameStartsWith
parameters.description:
Return records whose name starts with this value.

Matches records where the `FullName` begins with this string.
Example: Searching "Mac" returns "MacPherson", "MacGyver", etc.

parameters.name: nameEndsWith
parameters.description:
Return records whose name ends with this value.

Matches records where the `FullName` finishes with this string.
Example: Searching "kitchen" returns "John's Kitchen", "Central Kitchen", etc.

parameters.name: nameFrom
parameters.description:
Name range filter (start).

Returns records whose name is alphabetically at or after this value.

parameters.name: nameTo
parameters.description:
Name range filter (end).

Returns records whose name is alphabetically at or before this value.
If both `nameFrom` and `nameTo` are specified, `nameTo` must be lexicographically higher.

parameters.name: IncludeRetElementList
parameters.description:
Limit the response to only these top-level fields. Names must match exactly (case-sensitive QbXML element names e.g. ListIDRet, NameRet, AddressRet, PhoneRet  ).

**Note:** The names specified in the list are not parsed, so you must be especially careful to supply valid
names, properly cased. No error is returned in the status code if you specify an invalid name. Notice that if you want to
return custom data or private data extensions, you must specify the DataExtRet element and you must supply the OwnerID set
to either a value of 0 (custom data) or the GUID for the private data.
<example>["ListIDRet", "NameRet", "AddressRet", "PhoneRet"]</example>

parameters.name: ItemId
parameters.description:
(Optional) Filter for Price Levels that apply to a specific item (by ListID or FullName).
Maps to ItemRef in QBXML. Can be combined with MaxReturned and other filters.
Note: QBXML only supports a single ItemRef filter (not repeatable).

parameters.name: X-Connection-Id
parameters.description:
Identifies which QuickBooks Desktop company file to target.

Accepts three formats:
- **Prefixed ID**: `conn_01965a3f2e7b7000b4c1d2e3f4a5b6c7`
- **Internal GUID**: `3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6`
- **Your external ID**: `acme-corp` (the `externalId` you assigned when creating the connection)

The middleware resolves any of these formats to the correct connection. Required for all QuickBooks resource operations — without it, the API cannot determine which company file to query.

parameters.name: X-Nxus-Timeout-Seconds
parameters.description:
Maximum time in seconds to wait for the queued job to be picked up and the response returned from QuickBooks Desktop.

Create / update / delete and single-entity retrieval operations accept **1–120** seconds (default **120**). Raise this when the QuickBooks Web Connector is configured with longer polling intervals or the target company file is slow to respond.

Passed as a request header — not a query-string value.

get.description: Returns a list of SalesTaxCodes where the default limit is 500. **Note: Cursor-based pagination is NOT supported for this resource, so all available records (up to the limit) will be returned in a single response.**

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description:
The pagination cursor token used to retrieve the next set of records.

Capture the `nextCursor` from the response JSON and provide it here to continue fetching data.


**The 10-Second Rule:** Due to QuickBooks Desktop architectural requirements, you must request
the next page within **10 seconds** of receiving the previous response.


**Static Cursors:** Unlike some APIs, the cursor remains constant for the entire duration
of the fetch sequence until `hasMore` is `false`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return for this request.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description:
Filter by one or more unique identifiers (ListIDs).

Provide a list of strictly matched ListIDs. This is the most efficient way to retrieve specific records.

parameters.name: fullNames
parameters.description:
Filter by one or more exact full names.

Returns records whose `FullName` exactly matches any of the provided strings.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.

parameters.name: activeStatus
parameters.description: Shortcut for Filters.ActiveStatus - Filter by active status enum: ActiveOnly InactiveOnly ALL

parameters.name: updatedBefore
parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or before this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **23:59:59** (end of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.

parameters.name: updatedAfter
parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or after this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **00:00:00** (beginning of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.

parameters.name: nameContains
parameters.description:
Filter by name (substring match).

Matches records where the `FullName` contains this string.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.

parameters.name: nameStartsWith
parameters.description:
Return records whose name starts with this value.

Matches records where the `FullName` begins with this string.
Example: Searching "Mac" returns "MacPherson", "MacGyver", etc.

parameters.name: nameEndsWith
parameters.description:
Return records whose name ends with this value.

Matches records where the `FullName` finishes with this string.
Example: Searching "kitchen" returns "John's Kitchen", "Central Kitchen", etc.

parameters.name: nameFrom
parameters.description:
Name range filter (start).

Returns records whose name is alphabetically at or after this value.

parameters.name: nameTo
parameters.description:
Name range filter (end).

Returns records whose name is alphabetically at or before this value.
If both `nameFrom` and `nameTo` are specified, `nameTo` must be lexicographically higher.

parameters.name: IncludeRetElementList
parameters.description:
Limit the response to only these top-level fields. Names must match exactly (case-sensitive QbXML element names e.g. ListIDRet, NameRet, AddressRet, PhoneRet  ).

**Note:** The names specified in the list are not parsed, so you must be especially careful to supply valid
names, properly cased. No error is returned in the status code if you specify an invalid name. Notice that if you want to
return custom data or private data extensions, you must specify the DataExtRet element and you must supply the OwnerID set
to either a value of 0 (custom data) or the GUID for the private data.
<example>["ListIDRet", "NameRet", "AddressRet", "PhoneRet"]</example>

get.description: Returns a list of ShipMethods where the default limit is 500. **Note: Cursor-based pagination is NOT supported for this resource, so all available records (up to the limit) will be returned in a single response.**

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description:
The pagination cursor token used to retrieve the next set of records.

Capture the `nextCursor` from the response JSON and provide it here to continue fetching data.


**The 10-Second Rule:** Due to QuickBooks Desktop architectural requirements, you must request
the next page within **10 seconds** of receiving the previous response.


**Static Cursors:** Unlike some APIs, the cursor remains constant for the entire duration
of the fetch sequence until `hasMore` is `false`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return for this request.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description:
Filter by one or more unique identifiers (ListIDs).

Provide a list of strictly matched ListIDs. This is the most efficient way to retrieve specific records.

parameters.name: fullNames
parameters.description:
Filter by one or more exact full names.

Returns records whose `FullName` exactly matches any of the provided strings.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.

parameters.name: activeStatus
parameters.description: Shortcut for Filters.ActiveStatus - Filter by active status enum: ActiveOnly InactiveOnly ALL

parameters.name: updatedBefore
parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or before this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **23:59:59** (end of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.

parameters.name: updatedAfter
parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or after this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **00:00:00** (beginning of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.

parameters.name: nameContains
parameters.description:
Filter by name (substring match).

Matches records where the `FullName` contains this string.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.

parameters.name: nameStartsWith
parameters.description:
Return records whose name starts with this value.

Matches records where the `FullName` begins with this string.
Example: Searching "Mac" returns "MacPherson", "MacGyver", etc.

parameters.name: nameEndsWith
parameters.description:
Return records whose name ends with this value.

Matches records where the `FullName` finishes with this string.
Example: Searching "kitchen" returns "John's Kitchen", "Central Kitchen", etc.

parameters.name: nameFrom
parameters.description:
Name range filter (start).

Returns records whose name is alphabetically at or after this value.

parameters.name: nameTo
parameters.description:
Name range filter (end).

Returns records whose name is alphabetically at or before this value.
If both `nameFrom` and `nameTo` are specified, `nameTo` must be lexicographically higher.

parameters.name: IncludeRetElementList
parameters.description:
Limit the response to only these top-level fields. Names must match exactly (case-sensitive QbXML element names e.g. ListIDRet, NameRet, AddressRet, PhoneRet  ).

**Note:** The names specified in the list are not parsed, so you must be especially careful to supply valid
names, properly cased. No error is returned in the status code if you specify an invalid name. Notice that if you want to
return custom data or private data extensions, you must specify the DataExtRet element and you must supply the OwnerID set
to either a value of 0 (custom data) or the GUID for the private data.
<example>["ListIDRet", "NameRet", "AddressRet", "PhoneRet"]</example>

parameters.name: X-Connection-Id
parameters.description:
Identifies which QuickBooks Desktop company file to target.

Accepts three formats:
- **Prefixed ID**: `conn_01965a3f2e7b7000b4c1d2e3f4a5b6c7`
- **Internal GUID**: `3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6`
- **Your external ID**: `acme-corp` (the `externalId` you assigned when creating the connection)

The middleware resolves any of these formats to the correct connection. Required for all QuickBooks resource operations — without it, the API cannot determine which company file to query.

parameters.name: X-Correlation-ID
parameters.description:
A unique identifier for tracing a single request through the entire system.
If not provided by the client, a new one will be generated.
This is not persisted and is used only for logging and monitoring.

parameters.name: X-Nxus-Timeout-Seconds
parameters.description:
Maximum time in seconds to wait for the queued job to be picked up and the response returned from QuickBooks Desktop.

List and streaming query operations accept **1–90** seconds (default **90**). Raise this when the QuickBooks Web Connector is configured with longer polling intervals or the target company file is slow to respond.

Passed as a request header — not a query-string value.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of Terms where the default limit is 150.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description:
The pagination cursor token used to retrieve the next set of records.

Capture the `nextCursor` from the response JSON and provide it here to continue fetching data.


**The 10-Second Rule:** Due to QuickBooks Desktop architectural requirements, you must request
the next page within **10 seconds** of receiving the previous response.


**Static Cursors:** Unlike some APIs, the cursor remains constant for the entire duration
of the fetch sequence until `hasMore` is `false`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description:
Filter by one or more unique identifiers (ListIDs).

Provide a list of strictly matched ListIDs. This is the most efficient way to retrieve specific records.

parameters.name: fullNames
parameters.description:
Filter by one or more exact full names.

Returns records whose `FullName` exactly matches any of the provided strings.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.

parameters.name: activeStatus
parameters.description: Shortcut for Filters.ActiveStatus - Filter by active status enum: ActiveOnly InactiveOnly ALL

parameters.name: updatedBefore
parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or before this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **23:59:59** (end of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.

parameters.name: updatedAfter
parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or after this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **00:00:00** (beginning of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.

parameters.name: nameContains
parameters.description:
Filter by name (substring match).

Matches records where the `FullName` contains this string.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.

parameters.name: nameStartsWith
parameters.description:
Return records whose name starts with this value.

Matches records where the `FullName` begins with this string.
Example: Searching "Mac" returns "MacPherson", "MacGyver", etc.

parameters.name: nameEndsWith
parameters.description:
Return records whose name ends with this value.

Matches records where the `FullName` finishes with this string.
Example: Searching "kitchen" returns "John's Kitchen", "Central Kitchen", etc.

parameters.name: nameFrom
parameters.description:
Name range filter (start).

Returns records whose name is alphabetically at or after this value.

parameters.name: nameTo
parameters.description:
Name range filter (end).

Returns records whose name is alphabetically at or before this value.
If both `nameFrom` and `nameTo` are specified, `nameTo` must be lexicographically higher.

parameters.name: IncludeRetElementList
parameters.description:
Limit the response to only these top-level fields. Names must match exactly (case-sensitive QbXML element names e.g. ListIDRet, NameRet, AddressRet, PhoneRet  ).

**Note:** The names specified in the list are not parsed, so you must be especially careful to supply valid
names, properly cased. No error is returned in the status code if you specify an invalid name. Notice that if you want to
return custom data or private data extensions, you must specify the DataExtRet element and you must supply the OwnerID set
to either a value of 0 (custom data) or the GUID for the private data.
<example>["ListIDRet", "NameRet", "AddressRet", "PhoneRet"]</example>

parameters.name: X-Connection-Id
parameters.description:
Identifies which QuickBooks Desktop company file to target.

Accepts three formats:
- **Prefixed ID**: `conn_01965a3f2e7b7000b4c1d2e3f4a5b6c7`
- **Internal GUID**: `3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6`
- **Your external ID**: `acme-corp` (the `externalId` you assigned when creating the connection)

The middleware resolves any of these formats to the correct connection. Required for all QuickBooks resource operations — without it, the API cannot determine which company file to query.

parameters.name: X-Correlation-ID
parameters.description:
A unique identifier for tracing a single request through the entire system.
If not provided by the client, a new one will be generated.
This is not persisted and is used only for logging and monitoring.

parameters.name: X-Nxus-Timeout-Seconds
parameters.description:
Maximum time in seconds to wait for the queued job to be picked up and the response returned from QuickBooks Desktop.

List and streaming query operations accept **1–90** seconds (default **90**). Raise this when the QuickBooks Web Connector is configured with longer polling intervals or the target company file is slow to respond.

Passed as a request header — not a query-string value.

get.description: Returns a list of UnitOfMeasureSets where the default limit is 500. **Note: Cursor-based pagination is NOT supported for this resource, so all available records (up to the limit) will be returned in a single response.**

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description:
The pagination cursor token used to retrieve the next set of records.

Capture the `nextCursor` from the response JSON and provide it here to continue fetching data.


**The 10-Second Rule:** Due to QuickBooks Desktop architectural requirements, you must request
the next page within **10 seconds** of receiving the previous response.


**Static Cursors:** Unlike some APIs, the cursor remains constant for the entire duration
of the fetch sequence until `hasMore` is `false`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return for this request.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description:
Filter by one or more unique identifiers (ListIDs).

Provide a list of strictly matched ListIDs. This is the most efficient way to retrieve specific records.

parameters.name: fullNames
parameters.description:
Filter by one or more exact full names.

Returns records whose `FullName` exactly matches any of the provided strings.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.

parameters.name: activeStatus
parameters.description: Shortcut for Filters.ActiveStatus - Filter by active status enum: ActiveOnly InactiveOnly ALL

parameters.name: updatedBefore
parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or before this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **23:59:59** (end of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.

parameters.name: updatedAfter
parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or after this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **00:00:00** (beginning of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.

parameters.name: nameContains
parameters.description:
Filter by name (substring match).

Matches records where the `FullName` contains this string.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.

parameters.name: nameStartsWith
parameters.description:
Return records whose name starts with this value.

Matches records where the `FullName` begins with this string.
Example: Searching "Mac" returns "MacPherson", "MacGyver", etc.

parameters.name: nameEndsWith
parameters.description:
Return records whose name ends with this value.

Matches records where the `FullName` finishes with this string.
Example: Searching "kitchen" returns "John's Kitchen", "Central Kitchen", etc.

parameters.name: nameFrom
parameters.description:
Name range filter (start).

Returns records whose name is alphabetically at or after this value.

parameters.name: nameTo
parameters.description:
Name range filter (end).

Returns records whose name is alphabetically at or before this value.
If both `nameFrom` and `nameTo` are specified, `nameTo` must be lexicographically higher.

parameters.name: IncludeRetElementList
parameters.description:
Limit the response to only these top-level fields. Names must match exactly (case-sensitive QbXML element names e.g. ListIDRet, NameRet, AddressRet, PhoneRet  ).

**Note:** The names specified in the list are not parsed, so you must be especially careful to supply valid
names, properly cased. No error is returned in the status code if you specify an invalid name. Notice that if you want to
return custom data or private data extensions, you must specify the DataExtRet element and you must supply the OwnerID set
to either a value of 0 (custom data) or the GUID for the private data.
<example>["ListIDRet", "NameRet", "AddressRet", "PhoneRet"]</example>

parameters.name: X-Connection-Id
parameters.description:
Identifies which QuickBooks Desktop company file to target.

Accepts three formats:
- **Prefixed ID**: `conn_01965a3f2e7b7000b4c1d2e3f4a5b6c7`
- **Internal GUID**: `3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6`
- **Your external ID**: `acme-corp` (the `externalId` you assigned when creating the connection)

The middleware resolves any of these formats to the correct connection. Required for all QuickBooks resource operations — without it, the API cannot determine which company file to query.

parameters.name: X-Correlation-ID
parameters.description:
A unique identifier for tracing a single request through the entire system.
If not provided by the client, a new one will be generated.
This is not persisted and is used only for logging and monitoring.

parameters.name: X-Nxus-Timeout-Seconds

get.description: Returns a paginated list of Vendors where the default limit is 150.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description:
The pagination cursor token used to retrieve the next set of records.

Capture the `nextCursor` from the response JSON and provide it here to continue fetching data.


**The 10-Second Rule:** Due to QuickBooks Desktop architectural requirements, you must request
the next page within **10 seconds** of receiving the previous response.


**Static Cursors:** Unlike some APIs, the cursor remains constant for the entire duration
of the fetch sequence until `hasMore` is `false`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description:
Filter by one or more unique identifiers (ListIDs).

Provide a list of strictly matched ListIDs. This is the most efficient way to retrieve specific records.

parameters.name: fullNames
parameters.description:
Filter by one or more exact full names.

Returns records whose `FullName` exactly matches any of the provided strings.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.

parameters.name: activeStatus
parameters.description: Shortcut for Filters.ActiveStatus - Filter by active status enum: ActiveOnly InactiveOnly ALL

parameters.name: updatedBefore
parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or before this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **23:59:59** (end of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.

parameters.name: updatedAfter
parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or after this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **00:00:00** (beginning of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.

parameters.name: nameContains
parameters.description:
Filter by name (substring match).

Matches records where the `FullName` contains this string.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.

parameters.name: nameStartsWith
parameters.description:
Return records whose name starts with this value.

Matches records where the `FullName` begins with this string.
Example: Searching "Mac" returns "MacPherson", "MacGyver", etc.

parameters.name: nameEndsWith
parameters.description:
Return records whose name ends with this value.

Matches records where the `FullName` finishes with this string.
Example: Searching "kitchen" returns "John's Kitchen", "Central Kitchen", etc.

parameters.name: nameFrom
parameters.description:
Name range filter (start).

Returns records whose name is alphabetically at or after this value.

parameters.name: nameTo
parameters.description:
Name range filter (end).

Returns records whose name is alphabetically at or before this value.
If both `nameFrom` and `nameTo` are specified, `nameTo` must be lexicographically higher.

parameters.name: IncludeRetElementList
parameters.description:
Limit the response to only these top-level fields. Names must match exactly (case-sensitive QbXML element names e.g. ListIDRet, NameRet, AddressRet, PhoneRet  ).

parameters.name: X-Connection-Id
parameters.description:
Identifies which QuickBooks Desktop company file to target.

Accepts three formats:
- **Prefixed ID**: `conn_01965a3f2e7b7000b4c1d2e3f4a5b6c7`
- **Internal GUID**: `3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6`
- **Your external ID**: `acme-corp` (the `externalId` you assigned when creating the connection)

The middleware resolves any of these formats to the correct connection. Required for all QuickBooks resource operations — without it, the API cannot determine which company file to query.

parameters.name: X-Nxus-Timeout-Seconds
parameters.description:
Maximum time in seconds to wait for the queued job to be picked up and the response returned from QuickBooks Desktop.

Create / update / delete and single-entity retrieval operations accept **1–120** seconds (default **120**). Raise this when the QuickBooks Web Connector is configured with longer polling intervals or the target company file is slow to respond.

Passed as a request header — not a query-string value.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of VendorTypes where the default limit is 150.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description:
The pagination cursor token used to retrieve the next set of records.

Capture the `nextCursor` from the response JSON and provide it here to continue fetching data.


**The 10-Second Rule:** Due to QuickBooks Desktop architectural requirements, you must request
the next page within **10 seconds** of receiving the previous response.


**Static Cursors:** Unlike some APIs, the cursor remains constant for the entire duration
of the fetch sequence until `hasMore` is `false`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description:
Filter by one or more unique identifiers (ListIDs).

Provide a list of strictly matched ListIDs. This is the most efficient way to retrieve specific records.

parameters.name: fullNames
parameters.description:
Filter by one or more exact full names.

Returns records whose `FullName` exactly matches any of the provided strings.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.

parameters.name: activeStatus
parameters.description: Shortcut for Filters.ActiveStatus - Filter by active status enum: ActiveOnly InactiveOnly ALL

parameters.name: updatedBefore
parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or before this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **23:59:59** (end of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.

parameters.name: updatedAfter
parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or after this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **00:00:00** (beginning of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.

parameters.name: nameContains
parameters.description:
Filter by name (substring match).

Matches records where the `FullName` contains this string.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.

parameters.name: nameStartsWith
parameters.description:
Return records whose name starts with this value.

Matches records where the `FullName` begins with this string.
Example: Searching "Mac" returns "MacPherson", "MacGyver", etc.

parameters.name: nameEndsWith
parameters.description:
Return records whose name ends with this value.

Matches records where the `FullName` finishes with this string.
Example: Searching "kitchen" returns "John's Kitchen", "Central Kitchen", etc.

parameters.name: nameFrom
parameters.description:
Name range filter (start).

Returns records whose name is alphabetically at or after this value.

parameters.name: nameTo
parameters.description:
Name range filter (end).

Returns records whose name is alphabetically at or before this value.
If both `nameFrom` and `nameTo` are specified, `nameTo` must be lexicographically higher.

parameters.name: IncludeRetElementList
parameters.description:
Limit the response to only these top-level fields. Names must match exactly (case-sensitive QbXML element names e.g. ListIDRet, NameRet, AddressRet, PhoneRet  ).

**Note:** The names specified in the list are not parsed, so you must be especially careful to supply valid
names, properly cased. No error is returned in the status code if you specify an invalid name. Notice that if you want to
return custom data or private data extensions, you must specify the DataExtRet element and you must supply the OwnerID set
to either a value of 0 (custom data) or the GUID for the private data.
<example>["ListIDRet", "NameRet", "AddressRet", "PhoneRet"]</example>

parameters.name: X-Connection-Id
parameters.description:

Accepts three formats:
- **Prefixed ID**: `conn_01965a3f2e7b7000b4c1d2e3f4a5b6c7`

The middleware resolves any of these formats to the correct connection. Required for all QuickBooks resource operations — without it, the API cannot determine which company file to query.

parameters.name: X-Correlation-ID
parameters.description:
A unique identifier for tracing a single request through the entire system.
If not provided by the client, a new one will be generated.
This is not persisted and is used only for logging and monitoring.
